title: Technical Operations Specialist — GHL, Web & Tracking (Part-Time ? Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:

Kinetic Marketing Co. is a fast-growing digital marketing agency based in Melbourne, Australia. We help trades and home service businesses grow through paid advertising, automation, and high-converting websites. title: Amazon Product Sourcing & Research | China Negotiation | 3+ Years PL Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust)

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier, how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

2. Walk me through your evaluation process for a Private Label product - what metrics matter most to you, what makes you say no, and what makes you say yes? Give a real example without naming the product. What's your process, not your tools.

3. What tools do you use daily for Amazon product research, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - walk me through one specific thing you do in it that most people skip or don't know about.

4. What's the biggest mistake you've seen (or made) in product development, and what did you change after? Be specific.

title: Amazon Catalog manager
description:
We’re looking for a remote Amazon Catalog manager who can help us boost our product visibility, optimize product listings, and ensure that every listing is fully optimized to maximize sales and conversions. If you’re passionate about e-commerce, product research, and driving organic traffic to product pages, this role is for you.

This is a long-term position, and the salary starts at $3-4/h, 40 hours per week with the possibility of working overtime.



Key Responsibilities:

-Account Management: Oversee day-to-day operations of our Amazon account, ensuring all listings, content, and storefronts are up-to-date, compliant, and optimized for performance.

-SEO & Keyword Research: Perform keyword research using tools like Helium 10 to boost product rankings, enhance discoverability, and drive organic traffic.

-Product Listing Optimization: Manage and improve product listings, including titles, bullet points, descriptions, and backend keywords, to maximize conversions and visibility.

-Brand Strategy & Consistency: Work to ensure brand consistency across all Amazon touchpoints, including listings, A+ Content, and storefronts. Help refine our brand’s messaging and position on Amazon to align with our growth goals.

-Collaboration with PPC & Design Teams: Coordinate with the PPC team to align paid advertising efforts with SEO strategies. -Collaborate with freelance graphic designers to produce high-quality images, packaging, and other A+ Content.

-Performance Monitoring & Reporting: Track and analyze account metrics, such as organic rankings, CTR, and conversion rates, to measure the effectiveness of strategies and identify areas for improvement.

-Customer Insights & Feedback: Review customer feedback and reviews to identify product improvement opportunities and refine listing content accordingly.



Requirements:

-2+ years of experience in Amazon SEO and listing optimization.

-Experience with Helium 10 or similar tools for keyword research.

-Familiarity with Amazon’s ranking algorithm and SEO best practices.

-Knowledge of Amazon’s listing requirements, guidelines, and optimization tactics.

-Proficient in SEO tools, AI content tools, and Excel.

-Strong attention to detail and excellent English communication skills.



Why Work with Us?:

-Fully remote position, starting at 7 AM EEST.

-Opportunity to grow with a fast-growing e-commerce brand.

-Access to continuous professional development and training.

-Bi-weekly payments and a supportive, international team.

-Other benefits will be offered after 6 months of employment, such as minimum days of paid leave, health insurance, SSS, and pag-ibig...



To Apply:

Please include your CV and the word ‘SEO’ in the subject line of your application to be considered.

title: Outbound Cold Caller — $1,200/month + $50 per show-up appointment
description:
Why experienced setters join us



We created a role where your effort and results directly impact what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that is serious about helping you grow.



If you’re experienced, consistent, and take your work seriously, this is a place where you can build something long-term.



01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your income grows with your performance. The compensation structure is clear, the targets are realistic, and there is no limit to what you can earn each month.



02 — Leadership that helps you improve



You’ll work closely with a team that understands this business and knows what works. We share proven strategies, coach you on what needs improvement, and help you sharpen your skills — including tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.



03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard, but we also support each other in reaching it. You’ll be surrounded by people who are serious about their work, their performance, and their growth.



Compensation — paid weekly via Wise



Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed

Per qualified appointment: $50 USD — paid on top of base

Status bonus: 10–20% of closed deals the following month



The status bonus — how it works



Set 12+ qualified appointments in a month and you unlock a percentage of every deal that closes the following month — regardless of when you originally set those leads.



Hit 12 appointments = 10%

Hit 16 appointments = 15%

Hit 20 appointments = 20%



The more consistent you are, the more it compounds. At Bronze level, that’s an additional ~$375/month. At Gold level, that can be an additional ~$1,250/month — all on top of your base salary and per-appointment pay.



Working hours



9:00am – 5:30pm Eastern Time (ET)

That is 10:00pm – 6:30am Philippine Time (PHT).



This is a night shift role, and we want to be fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that’s you, and you’re comfortable with the schedule, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We’ll walk you through the script, CRM, process, and call flow until you feel confident.



To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable goal, and we’ll be coaching you throughout the process to help you get there.



What you’ll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.



Identify real needs and book qualified appointments with businesses that are ready to receive a cleaning quote.



Deliver a proven script in a natural and conversational way — not robotic or mechanical.



Keep your pipeline, notes, and call logs updated accurately in the CRM each day.



Receive ongoing coaching and access to strategies that have already proven to work.



Who we’re looking for



2+ years of experience in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.



A professional and natural phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not just a caller.



The ability to learn a script and deliver it as a real conversation.



A stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.



Comfort using a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.



What you’re walking into



You’re joining a company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously.



You’ll know exactly what is expected, exactly how you get paid, and exactly how you can grow.



We’re looking for people who want to stay, improve, and build with us long term.



Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.

Raise questions in real time rather than allowing uncertainty to produce errors downstream

Use Timely (AI time tracker) to log and summarise daily activity accurately

Experience

Experience recruiting for high-volume, casual workforces is a significant advantage

Background in environmental, agricultural, construction, or field operations industries preferred — strong fast learners considered

 — project and employee management; prior use preferred, training available

Microsoft Office / Google Suite — document management and reporting

Proactive communicator: raises questions as they arise, does not sit on uncertainty

Reliable about availability: logs in and out clearly and communicates schedule changes without being asked

Comfortable in a virtual online office — active participant, not a reluctant observer

Confident working independently through a task list and escalating when something doesn't look right





You'll Thrive Here If You Are…

Numbers-confident — Genuinely at ease working with data, payroll figures, and cross-referenced spreadsheets all day. This is not a role for someone who tolerates numbers; it's for someone who is comfortable making them their core daily output.

Accountable by default — When something goes wrong, your first instinct is to understand why and prevent it from happening again — not to deflect, minimise, or repeat the same mistake.

Proactively autonomous — You don't wait to be prompted. You move through the task list, communicate progress, and flag issues before they become problems.

Composed under pressure — Peak season gets intense, but the pressure is manageable when you stay ahead of the work. You chase inputs early, cross-check on the day things are due, and keep work moving so the crunch never compounds.

Detail-obsessed — You catch the small things — the mismatched hour, the missing induction record, the VEVO check coming due. Routine accuracy is never treated as a low priority.

A reliable communicator — The team always knows when you're in. You log on when you start, communicate breaks or unavailability, and respond within a reasonable timeframe. Transparent availability is the baseline, not a bonus.

An initiative-taker — You see what's coming, prepare for it, and surface things the team doesn't yet know they need to know. You create tasks, not just tick them.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
Full-Time Digital Marketing Specialist - Google Ads, Meta, SEO (Shopify eCommerce)



About us

Waxit International is an Australian eCommerce and service business operating across multiple brands, including a fast-growing Shopify store. We've been in online retail for close to 15 years and know what good marketing looks like - we're now looking for the right person to help us do more of it.



The role

You'll help manage our paid ads (Meta + Google) and SEO across the business - primarily eCommerce, with campaigns also supporting our service lines. We want someone who genuinely loves performance marketing, thinks strategically, and brings ideas to the table rather than just executing tasks. This is a long-term, stable role with room to grow as the business grows.



What you'll be doing

- Build, launch, monitor, analyse and scale Google Ads campaigns (Search, Performance Max, AI Max, Shopping, Display)

- Build, monitor, analyse and scale Meta Ads 
 & Instagram) for both eCommerce and lead gen

- Manage and improve SEO - keyword research, on-page, technical, content briefs

- Set up and maintain tracking (Google suit of tracking, meta tracking, 3rd party tracking such as Triple Whale & more)

- Manage Shopify campaign integrations - product feeds, conversion tracking, app setup & more

- Report on performance honestly, and stay up to date with what's actively happening - what's working, what's not, what to try next, what's new, etc. 

- Stay across platform changes and emerging trends, and proactively suggest improvements

- Collaborate on creative briefs, landing page improvements, and CRO



Must have

- 3+ years hands-on experience running both Google Ads AND Meta Ads (not just one)

- Strong SEO foundation - technical and content

- Working knowledge of Shopify (apps, product feeds, conversion tracking, theme basics)

- Excellent written and spoken English - you'll be on calls with us regularly

- Strategic thinker, not just an executor

- Confident across GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, and Shopify analytics



Nice to have

- Triple Whale experience (attribution and analytics)

- Klaviyo or
 marketing experience

- CRO and landing page optimisation experience

- Experience with Australian, US, or UK market eCommerce brands



The details

- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Long-term, stable role with room to grow

- Some overlap with Australian business working hours preferred (2-4 hours per day)

- Pay: AUD $1,600–$2,600/month depending on experience



We're flexible on how we engage you, depending on what works best for you:

- Employer of Record option - full-time employment through a registered Philippine EOR, with all statutory benefits (13th month pay, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, paid leave)

- Independent contractor option - if you have an established freelance practice and prefer to invoice us directly, we're open to that. Paid via Easypay.

Let us know in your application which you'd prefer and why.



How to apply

Please complete the following:

- A short intro about you and why this role interests you

- 2–3 specific examples of campaigns you've run - include the platform, your role, what you did, and the results (numbers please, not fluff)

- Your monthly rate expectation in AUD

- Your preferred engagement structure (EOR or contractor)

- Start your application with the word "Mango" so we know you've actually read this ad

- We read every application personally and will respond to shortlisted candidates within a week.

title: DTC Creative Strategist — Fast-Scaling DTC Supplement Ecom Brand
description:
Hiring: Senior Direct Response Creative Strategist



JFM Ventures is the operator group behind a fast-scaling DTC supplement brand. We're doing multiple 7 figures a month and on pace for multiple 8 figures by the end of the year. That's just the starting line. Our vision is to build a multiple 9 figure household supplement brand that sits in the largest retailers in the nation, right alongside the biggest names in the category.



YOUR MISSION

Your mission is to create the winning ads that scale this brand. You'll crack new avatars and angles, turn them into concepts that convert on cold traffic, and then squeeze every winner for everything it's worth through relentless iteration. You own the creative engine, from research and angles to hooks, briefs, and the testing roadmap that d
 what we run next. You don't just pitch ideas, you own whether they win. The best people here care more about what converts than what looks good in a portfolio.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- Crack new winning avatars, angles, and hooks across our core formats like native statics, video scripts, VSL, AI, and UGC

- Build iterations off every winner to scale it as far as it will go before it fatigues

- Mine voice-of-customer insight (reviews, Reddit, comments, competitor ads) and turn it into angles people actually respond to

- Write sharp briefs and scripts your editors and designers can execute against without guesswork

- Own the testing roadmap, d
 what gets tested, reading the performance data in the ad account, and calling the winner

- Maintain a living angle and hook library so the team always has the next test queued

- Diagnose losers fast and turn the insight into the next concept to run

- Apply direct response fundamentals to everything, because you understand what makes people buy

- Operate with high autonomy, managing your testing cadence and pipeline without hand-holding

- As a foundational tea
mber, help set our creative standards and onboard future strategists as we scale



OUR TECH STACK

- Data & Attribution. Triple Whale, Meta Ads Manager

- Briefs & Project Management. Google Drive, ClickUp

- AI Avatar & Generation. HeyGen, Google Flow, Hedra

- Voiceover. ElevenLabs

- Image Generation. Midjourney, Krea

- Communication. Slack



KPIs YOU WILL OWN

Your KPIs and output targets depend on the format you specialize in (native statics, video scripts, VSL, AI, UGC), but across the board you own:

- Hit Rate. A strong and rising percentage of your concepts becoming winners

- Output. A steady volume of net-new tested angles and iterations every week, scaled to your format

- Performance. ROAS and CPA on the creative you direct, and how much profitable spend your winners can hold as we scale



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven direct response creative strategy experience at a brand doing $10M+ per year. Non-negotiable

- A portfolio of ads with real performance behind them, including winning concepts, hit rate, and total spend your creatives have run on Meta

- Deep command of DR fundamentals like avatars, mechanisms, hooks, pacing, retention, and what drives conversions

- Sharp at voice-of-customer research and translating raw insight into testable angles

- Data-driven, able to read ad account performance and turn it into better creative decisions

- Strong copywriting instincts and the ability to brief editors and UGC creators clearly

- Experience in health, wellness, or supplements is a strong plus

High autonomy operator who runs their own testing cycles without being managed

- Strong written English for briefs, scripts, and communication

- Genuinely obsessed with creative performance, not just creative craft



WHY JOIN JFM VENTURES

- Aggressive ad spend % performance bonus. When your creative scales profitable spend, you get paid for it

- High impact work. Your angles run on real spend and reach real buyers every single day

- Direct line to founders and the creative team, with no layers and no politics

- Early tea
mber advantage. Top performers will be given opportunities to lead and grow

- Fully remote. We measure output, not hours

- Fast-moving environment. Multiple 7 figures a month and climbing, the pace is real



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

- You need constant direction to stay productive

- You look to competitors for every idea instead of doing your own research

- You think like a traditional art director, disconnected from paid social data

- You're uncomfortable with tools, formats, and angles changing fast. Our environment shifts and you have to move with it

- You don't have real direct response experience. Brand and social content is not the same thing

- You see this as a freelance side project. This is full-time and we need full commitment

- Paid media and DR marketing doesn't genuinely excite you. If it's just a job, this isn't the right fit



HOW TO APPLY

If you live and breathe direct response and you can prove your ads have moved real money, we want to hear from you.



At the top of your application, list a few of the top brands you've worked with, then walk us through the single best ad you've made, the results it drove, and the psychology behind why it worked.



Fill out the full application below. We review every application personally and if there's a fit, we'll be in touch shortly. Looking forward to speaking soon!

title: Project Coordinator - ERP
description:
Our company 

Pablo & Rusty’s Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster based in Sydney, Australia. We’re a B-Corp, 1% for the Planet, and Carbon Neutral Certified specialty coffee roaster committed to social, environmental, and impact goals and striving to help folks Drink Better Coffee™.  



Our mission is to positively impact people and our planet through coffee. We source specialty coffee directly from coffee farms and provide exceptional service to both wholesale and retail customers.  



We're a digital, design-centric, and sustainable company. Innovation drives everything we do, and we always look for ways to improve. We have high expectations of our tea
mbers and work collaboratively to achieve our goals. 



Join the team 

We are looking for an ERP Project Coordinator to drive the delivery of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central programme, and other transformation projects as they come. This is a pure delivery role: you keep the plan on track, hold our partner and team to their commitments, and keep everything moving so nothing falls through the cracks. You won't be the technical builder; your craft is organisation, coordination, communication and 
ntum. 



Key duties and responsibilities: 

• Maintain and drive the project plan, schedule, milestones and dependencies, and run the cadence of meetings and follow-ups 

• Coordinate the implementation partner and internal team, holding both to agreed commitments and timelines 

• Manage issue, risk and decision logs, and escalate appropriately and on time 

• Coordinate testing, training logistics and go-live readiness, and keep communication flowing to the sponsor and business 

• Track project budget against plan, flag variances early, and support the transition to business-as-usual 



Qualifications and knowledge: 

• Demonstrated experience coordinating projects in a multi-stakeholder client and vendor environment (essential) 

• Experience on ERP or Microsoft Dynamics implementations is ideal; a PMP or PRINCE2 certification is highly regarded 

• Excellent organisation, coordination and follow-through, with the confidence to hold vendors and senior stakeholders to account 

• Outstanding written and verbal English, and the ability to work independently across time zones 

• Experience in manufacturing, wholesale or food and beverage, and familiarity with change management, are an advantage 



What's in it for you 

First up: we want this role to be the best job you've ever had. That's our commitment to all of our team! That's not to say the work will be easy. It will, however, be fulfilling. You will grow personally and professionally, surrounded by a team that genuinely cares about our mission and about helping each other achieve it. 



We offer a generous package, HMO Program**, Quarterly Performance Bonus*, Volunteer and Training Leave, Philippine Public Holidays converted to Annual Leave Credits, access to ongoing training and development, and an Employee Assistance Program (EAP). 



Importantly, you'll have first dibs on P&R merchandise (shirts, hoodies, jumpers and more) and get P&R coffee delivered directly to your place every month!

title: Virtual Bookkeeping Assistant – Daily Deposits & Sales Reconciliation

About the Role

We operate a portfolio of campgrounds, RV resorts, and family entertainment centers across the U.S. We are looking for a meticulous, self-directed virtual bookkeeping assistant to handle daily sales entry and deposit reconciliation in QuickBooks Desktop/Enterprise across multiple properties.

QuickBooks is hosted on a remote server — you will log in via remote desktop connection (RDP) to do your work. A reliable, fast internet connection is essential.

This is a long-term, part-time position with consistent recurring work and the opportunity to grow with our team.



What You’ll Do

• Reconcile daily bank deposits against recorded sales and physical paperwork

• Identify and flag discrepancies between POS/software reports, deposit amounts, and QuickBooks entries

• Maintain organized, property-by-property digital records

• Communicate clearly with our team when questions or discrepancies arise





Requirements

• Hands-on QuickBooks Desktop or Enterprise experience — you must be comfortable with daily journal entries, deposit recording, and category/class allocations (please describe your experience in your application)

• Comfortable accessing software via remote desktop connection (RDP) — this is how QuickBooks is accessed; you will not be installing anything locally

• Strong attention to detail — you will be matching numbers across multiple sources daily, and accuracy is non-negotiable

• Comfortable learning new software quickly (we use campground management and FEC point-of-sale systems; training will be provided)

• Able to work independently and manage a daily task routine without reminders

• Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace

• Good written English communication skills





Nice to Have

• Experience working with multi-location or multi-entity businesses in QuickBooks Desktop or Enterprise

• Prior experience with hospitality, recreation, or retail POS systems

• Familiarity with tools like Teams and Excel

• Prior experience working with U.S.-based clients





How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. A description of your QuickBooks Desktop/Enterprise experience — specifically, have you done daily deposit entry, class/category allocations, or multi-location bookkeeping? Have you used it via remote desktop (RDP)?

2. Any bookkeeping or accounting certifications you hold

3. Examples of similar work (business type, volume of transactions, number of locations)

4. Your availability and time zone



We review every application carefully and will respond to qualified candidates promptly. We look forward to finding a great long-term fit!

description:
About Us

We operate approximately 12 campgrounds, RV parks, and family entertainment centers across Indiana, Florida, and Branson, Missouri. Our properties share a consistent brand identity built around wholesome, family-friendly outdoor experiences. We are growing quickly and need a social media professional who can build and manage a high-performing presence across all locations — someone who thinks strategically, creates compelling content, and uses modern AI tools to work efficiently at scale.

The Role

This is not a “post and pray” job. We need a strategic, creative, and self-directed content manager who owns our social presence end-to-end: build the strategy, create the content, schedule it, analyze results, and continuously improve. You will manage
, Instagram, and TikTok for all 12 locations under a consistent brand voice while giving each property its own personality.

What You’ll Do

Strategy & Planning

• Develop and maintain a monthly content calendar across
, Instagram, and TikTok for all 12 locations.

• Build platform-specific strategies that drive engagement, followers, and campground bookings.

• Research seasonal trends, competitor accounts, and family/outdoor travel content to continuously sharpen the strategy.

• Select, set up, and manage a social media scheduling and analytics platform for the full portfolio (you will recommend the tool).

• Provide monthly performance reports with key metrics and strategic recommendations.



Content Creation

• Write engaging, platform-native captions with strong hooks and calls to action.

• Create short-form video content (Reels and TikToks) — scripting, editing, and publishing — using footage from our location teams and AI-assisted or stock assets where appropriate.

• Design graphics, promotional posts, and story assets (Canva proficiency required at minimum).

• Use AI tools, including Claude, to ideate, draft, and scale content production efficiently — and be able to show how you do this.

• Maintain a warm, family-friendly, adventurous brand voice consistently across all content.



Scheduling & Community

• Schedule and publish all content on time using your chosen scheduling platform.

• Monitor comments and DMs across all accounts; respond to common inquiries or escalate as needed.

• Flag trending audio, formats, or seasonal opportunities for quick-turn content.

Requirements

Must-Have

• Proven experience managing social media for a business or brand — portfolio links required.

• Demonstrated experience creating Reels and TikToks, including editing.

• Strong English writing: clear, compelling, grammatically clean.

• Fluency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) as part of your daily content workflow.

• Experience with a social media scheduling platform across multiple accounts.

• Self-directed and reliable: you meet deadlines, communicate proactively, and do not need to be micromanaged.



Strongly Preferred

• Experience managing accounts for multiple brand locations simultaneously.

• Background in travel, outdoor recreation, hospitality, or family-focused content.

• Graphic design skills beyond basic Canva use.

• Familiarity with TikTok-specific trends and content formats.

• Experience interpreting social media analytics to guide strategy.

How to Apply

To be considered, your application MUST include all of the following:

• Links to 2–3 business social media accounts you currently manage or have managed.

• At least 2 examples of Reels or TikTok videos you created and edited.

• A short paragraph (3–5 sentences) describing how you would approach building a content strategy for a multi-location family entertainment brand.

• Your recommended social media scheduling tool and a brief reason why.

Applications without portfolio examples will not be reviewed.

title: Google Business Profile and Local SEO Specialist

title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist (Facebook Ads / Meta Ads) - Lead Generation, Healthcare & Legal
description:
Senior Media Buyer / Creative Strategist  (Meta Ads) - Lead Generation, Healthcare & Legal

About the Role



We're a performance-based lead generation company running Meta advertising campaigns across two verticals: healthcare intake and legal case intake. This is a direct-response, lead generation focused role, not branding or awareness work. A core part of this job is ongoing competitor research and analysis, you'll be constantly studying what's working across the industry and turning that into real campaign decisions, not a one-time exercise. You'll be hands-on analyzing, managing, and scaling our actual Meta ad campaigns, not just advising from the sidelines. Our goals are qualified leads, higher call pick-up rates, and the ability to scale what works, raw volume alone isn't success here. Every campaign and creative decision should be judged by whether it moves us closer to those outcomes.

We have a creative production team that handles the actual execution of creatives (filming, editing, design). This role doesn't produce final assets, instead, you'll direct the production team by building mockups, pulling reference examples and swipe files, and writing the ad copy and scripts yourself, then handing that direction off for them to execute and produce.



Responsibilities

Research & Analysis



Continuously research and monitor Meta ad creative being run by competitors in the addiction treatment center space and the lemon law case intake space, across all formats: static images, AI-generated UGC, traditional UGC/video, and any other creative format that's performing

Analyze campaign and creative performance through the full lead generation funnel, with qualified leads as the north star, not just lead volume: which creatives produce qualified, billable leads for addiction treatment versus just raw volume, and which creatives drive actual signed lemon law cases

Identify which creative angles, hooks, formats, and targeting correlate with leads who actually answer the phone when called, not just leads who fill out a form

Turn ongoing research and performance data into specific, actionable recommendations on what to scale, kill, or iterate



Campaign Management & Creative Direction



Directly manage and analyze our live Meta ad campaigns across both verticals, day to day, not just at a strategic/advisory level

Write ad copy and scripts for both verticals based on what the research and live campaign data shows is working, across static, AI UGC, and video formats

Build mockups and pull reference examples/swipe files across all creative formats to give the production team clear creative direction, then hand off for them to film, edit, and design

Own campaign structure, management, and scaling across Meta ad accounts for both addiction treatment and lemon law lead generation, optimizing toward qualified lead volume and call pick-up rate over raw lead count

Build and manage testing frameworks across creative formats that let us scale winning campaigns without losing lead quality or pick-up rates as spend increases

Manage media buying day to day: budget allocation, bid/audience adjustments, scaling decisions, testing frameworks, audience and targeting strategy



Requirements



3-5+ years hands-on Meta Ads media buying experience, specifically in lead generation campaigns (not branding/awareness)

Strong research and analytical skills, this role lives in competitor research and performance data, not just execution

Strong copywriting skills, you'll be writing scripts and ad copy directly, not just reviewing someone else's

Experience working across multiple creative formats: static images, AI-generated UGC, traditional UGC/video, and emerging formats

Proven experience with lead generation in addiction treatment, behavioral health, personal injury/mass tort, lemon law, or another high-CPL/high-stakes vertical

Comfortable working with lead-to-qualified-to-conversion data and drawing creative conclusions from it, not just CPL/CTR

Track record of scaling campaigns successfully, meaning increasing spend while maintaining or improving lead quality and pick-up rates, not just maintaining volume

Comfortable directing a production team through mockups, references, and written briefs rather than producing final assets yourself

Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager and competitor ad research tools

Strong written and spoken English for daily collaboration with a US-based team

Comfortable working independently in a research and strategy-heavy role



Structure: Open to full-time or contract, based on fit



How to Apply



Submit your resume/portfolio along with specific examples of Meta ad accounts you've managed for lead generation, including any real performance results you can share (CPL, lead-to-qualified rate, call pick-up rate, conversion rate, etc.).

As part of your application, complete this exercise:

Find 2 active Meta ads from addiction treatment centers and 2 from lemon law companies. Include a link or screenshot for each.

For each of the 4 ads, tell us: is this creative built to maximize raw lead volume, or built to maximize lead quality (people who actually qualify and pick up the phone)? Point to the specific words, claims, or creative choices that gave it away, generic answers without specifics won't count.

Then pick ONE addiction treatment ad and ONE lemon law ad from your 4. For each, tell us: what's working well in this ad and what would you keep as-is? What would you change, and why, more volume, better qualified leads, higher pick-up rates, or something else? Be specific: point to actual wording, hooks, or claims you'd keep, cut, or rewrite, not just general impressions.

Finally, walk us through your approach separately for each vertical:

Addiction treatment: How would you approach competitor research, testing, and scaling for this vertical specifically? What's different about how you'd think about creative and qualification here?

Lemon law: Same question, how would your research, testing, and scaling approach differ for lemon law specifically, and why?

We want to see two distinct plans, not one generic answer applied twice. This exercise is the part of the application we weigh most heavily.

description:

asures themselves against. Someone who has done this work at a senior level, knows what great looks like from the inside, and is ready to build something.



About the Company:

We run an AI-native lifestyle management platform for the world's most demanding clients — founders, athletes, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals who expect their personal and professional lives to run without friction.



Our members do not manage logistics. We do. Across travel, dining, private experiences, luxury goods, and wellness — everything is handled, anticipated, and elevated by a team that operates at the highest level of personal service.



We have built the content operations side of this business. Now we are scaling the member experience function, and we need a Lead Lifestyle Manager to be the first senior hire in that team.

On the member side, you are managing a live queue of requests across multiple members simultaneously. Elevating confirmed plans, securing access that others cannot get, building partner relationships that make the impossible routine. The pace is high. The standard is higher.



On the leadership side, you are the benchmark. As the team scales, you will bring new Lifestyle Managers up to speed, review their work, and hold the quality line on every member interaction that goes out.



IMPORTANT: Please read the responsibilities section carefully before applying — we assess candidates directly on what is listed below, and the process is thorough by design.

* Competitive salary: $1,900 - $2,100 USD per month (depending on experience)



Benefits

* Paid time off

* Wellbeing stipend



Working Hours

* Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (EST)

* Full-time only (40 hours per week)

* This is a high-output role, especially in the early period as the team builds. We are looking for someone who is energised by that, not surprised by it.



Core Responsibilities



Member Experience

* Triage and manage a high-volume live queue across dining, experiences, wellness, and luxury goods simultaneously, at a pace.

* Elevate confirmed plans before members ask. Personal touches, upgraded access, and proactive picks that show you actually know them.

* Make outbound calls to hotels, restaurants, and venues globally to secure what others can't, and build the relationships that make that repeatable.

* Communicate with members and partners with precision and warmth. Right detail, right tone, right 
nt.

* Use our Claude-powered AI platform to research and build offers fast, applying your own judgment before anything reaches a member.

Team Leadership

* Onboard and upskill incoming Lifestyle Managers, transferring your instincts and standards to the people behind you.

* Review work, give direct feedback, and flag problems to leadership before they become issues.



You're Perfect for This Role If You

* Have 5+ years serving wealthy or high-profile principals in a senior client-facing role — five-star guest experience, principal-level EA, luxury concierge, or equivalent where the margin for error was zero.

* Have led or mentored a team before, formally or not, and understand what it means to be accountable for someone else's output.

* Pick up the phone first, know who to ask for, and never let "fully booked" be the end of the conversation.

* Notice what members need before they say it, not through research, but through the pattern recognition that comes from years of real client proximity.

* Have worked in high-volume, high-pressure environments where everything is urgent and you recalibrate rather than freeze.

* Handle confidential client information and NDA-bound relationships as a matter of course.

* Are professional and composed by default. Warm with members, direct with partners, serious when it counts.

title: Creative Strategist - DTC / E-Commerce (Remote, Freelance)
description:
Growing creative studio producing performance ads for DTC brands on Meta is looking for a creative strategist who can concept, write, and produce ad creative using AI tools. This is not a traditional design role. We care about marketing fundamentals, strong copy, and the ability to turn strategy into finished static ads and video scripts, not your Photoshop skills.

You'll be building ad concepts from the ground up. That means researching the brand and audience, writing the messaging, choosing the format, generating the visuals using AI tools, and delivering final assets ready to upload. We need someone who can think strategically about why an ad will work and then actually build it themselves, not just hand off a brief to someone else.

The brands we work with are DTC and e-commerce. The ads we make are intentionally raw, native, and ugly. Notes app screenshots, tweet style posts, fake text threads, comparison graphics, AI generated visuals, UGC style statics. If it looks like a real person posted it instead of a brand designing it, that's the goal. We also write scripts for UGC video ads and AI voiceover videos, so you need to be comfortable writing for both static and video formats.

AI is central to how we work. We use AI tools to generate visuals, write variations, build statics, and produce content faster than traditional workflows allow. If you're not already using AI tools daily in your creative process, this isn't the right fit. We're looking for someone who's ahead of the curve, not someone who needs to be convinced that AI is useful.

What you'll be doing



Concepting static ad ideas based on brand research, customer data, and performance insights

Writing headlines, ad copy, and full video scripts for DTC brands

Generating finished static ads using AI tools and Canva

Writing UGC video scripts and AI voiceover scripts with hook variations

Working from creative strategy documents and also building your own concepts independently

Producing 15-20+ static creatives and 5-10 video scripts per week across client accounts

Reviewing ad performance data and using it to inform what you create next

Iterating on winning concepts with new angles, formats, and variations



What you need



Experience in DTC or e-commerce advertising, specifically creating ads that ran on Meta or TikTok with real spend

Strong copywriting skills. You understand hooks, awareness stages, pain points, desire language, and how to write for someone who's never heard of the brand

Daily use of AI tools in your creative workflow. Whether that's Midjourney, ChatGPT, Claude, Runway, Flux, Ideogram, or whatever else you use, we need someone who's already deep in AI, not just experimenting

Understanding of direct response fundamentals. You know why an ad works, not just what it looks like. You can look at performance data and make creative decisions based on it

Ability to concept independently. We'll train you on our systems and strategy frameworks, but you need to be able to take a brand's research and come up with original ad concepts on your own

Self driven and communicative. You're active in our workflow daily, responsive, and proactive about flagging ideas or issues



What you don't need



Advanced graphic design skills. We don't use Photoshop or Illustrator. AI tools and Canva handle production

A portfolio of polished brand work. We make ugly ads intentionally. If your portfolio is full of clean corporate design, this probably isn't your lane

Video editing skills. We have a dedicated editor. You write the scripts and concepts, someone else cuts the footage



Bonus



You've worked at or with a DTC ad agency before

You understand Meta's ad delivery system and why creative diversity matters

You've written UGC scripts that were filmed by real creators

You follow the DTC ad space closely and can name 5 brands running great creative right now

You've used AI to build entire ad concepts end to end, not just generate images



Details



Remote, freelance

Monthly retainer with growth as client volume increases

Consistent weekly workload across multiple client accounts

Opportunity to grow into a senior role as the studio scales



To apply

D
 with:



3-5 examples of static ads or video scripts you've created for DTC or e-commerce brands

Which AI tools you use daily and how they fit into your workflow

One sentence on what makes a static ad stop the scroll

title: B2B Marketing & Social Media VA
description:
**PEO & Health Insurance Consulting Firm — Marketing & Social Media VA (Part-Time · Remote)**



**About AdviceHR**

AdviceHR exists because the health insurance and PEO industry is broken and most companies and their employees are paying the price. We're talking about people who are functionally uninsured, not getting proper medical care, and locked into medical plans they don't understand because a broker prioritized a commission over a family. We're here to change that. We help CEOs, CFOs, and CHROs cut through the noise, stop overpaying, and actually get coverage that works for their people.  We build things right, we move with intention, and everything we do is grounded in faith, integrity, and genuine care for the humans on the other side of every decision. If that resonates with you, you'll fit here.



We're hiring a part-time Marketing & Social Media VA who is a self-starter, knows exactly what they're doing, and is ready to bring their full skillset and unlimited creativity to a growing brand. If you thrive with ownership, want to earn extra bonuses based on results, and don't need hand-holding, this is your role.



This position will likely grow into a full-time role with an uncapped bonus/commission plan on top of hourly pay as the company grows. $0.25 per net new follower + $25/qualified inbound lead. Hourly rate based on experience.



**What You'll Own**



*LinkedIn: Personal Brand (Primary Focus)*

- Build and manage a monthly content calendar for the founder's personal LinkedIn profile

- Write, design, and schedule 3–5 posts per week

- Drive daily community engagement: comments, DMs, follower growth

- Generate inbound leads from C-suite decision makers and HR professionals through organic content and engagement strategy

- Support AdviceHR company brand presence as secondary focus

- Track and report growth metrics, engagement, and inbound lead activity



Some posts will be Christian-based about faith and life. Christianity is not a requirement, but you must be comfortable posting this type of content as part of the content strategy.



*Brand & Visual*

- Create graphics and visual assets for LinkedIn posts and campaigns

- Maintain a consistent, professional visual identity

- Manage and optimize the AdviceHR Google Business Profile

- Support general web presence and online visibility



*Future Growth (Phase 2 — Timeline TBD)*

- Podcast guest speaking coordination and media placements

- Newsletter management and subscriber growth

- Expanded content distribution or other recommendations for lead generation



If you have experience with podcast coordination or newsletter management, please mention that in your application as it's relevant to where this role is headed.



**Existing Tools**

LinkedIn, HubSpot, and open to any additional tools needed or tools you bring to the table.



**You Must Have**

- Proven experience managing LinkedIn for B2B executives or professional services firms

- Demonstrated success growing a LinkedIn presence with inbound leads generated or meetings booked from organic content, specific results required

- Portfolio showing measurable follower and engagement growth with real numbers

- Strong written English at an executive level, as you are ghostwriting for a U.S. consultant

- Experience creating graphics for LinkedIn content

- Ability to work independently, take full ownership, and bring creative ideas without being asked

- Reliable internet and partial overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours



HR or insurance industry experience is a plus.



**This Role Is NOT For You If**

- Your LinkedIn experience is B2C, lifestyle, or influencer-focused

- You cannot show specific growth metrics or inbound lead results from past clients or at a minimum provide references.

- You need daily direction to produce content

- You have never written for a U.S.-based executive or business





*Shortlisted candidates will be contacted within 10 business days.*

title: Client Experience Specialist for an AI start up
description:
If you’ve spent your career managing the personal world of a high-profile executive, VIP guests at a 5-star location, or high-net-worth clients at a luxury brand, you speak & write fluent English, and you know how to turn a good experience into an unforgettable one, this role is for you. Apply here: 
/appqyBZJyyxs1htVk/pagEQjq2vZKqXqN1G/form



Overview:

We are an AI-powered lifestyle management platform built for the world’s highest-performance founders, athletes, and family offices. Think of it as the operating system for someone’s entire personal life, travel, dining, exclusive experiences, luxury goods, and wellness all managed in one place by a team that genuinely goes the extra mile.



This is a role with a real growth path. If you want to grow into a leadership position, not just do a job, strong performers here will be the first in line to step up as the team scales.



What This Role Actually Looks Like

Here’s a concrete example. A member is flying to New York for three days. Their itinerary: check in to the Four Seasons, dinner at Nobu, a visit to the Met.

A good assistant books those things. You do something different.



You call the Four Seasons’ guest relations team, build a quick rapport, and arrange for two bottles of Dom Pérignon to be waiting in the room with a handwritten welcome card from the company.

Nobu is fully booked. You find the right contact, introduce yourself professionally, and get the table anyway - because you know how to talk to people who matter.

You reach out to the Met’s private tours team and arrange for a dedicated art historian to personally guide the member through the galleries, with refreshments waiting.



That’s the standard. Every member, every trip.



IMPORTANT: Please carefully read the responsibilities section below to ensure you’re a good fit, and follow the instructions on how to apply at the bottom



Compensation:

*Competitive salary: $1,400 – $1,500 USD per month (depending on experience)



Benefits:

PTO, Wellbeing Stipend, Growth path into a leadership role

Working Hours:

*Monday – Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (EST)

*This is a full-time role only (40 hours per week)



Core Responsibilities:

* Take a member’s confirmed plans and elevate them, coordinating room amenities, securing hard-to-get reservations, arranging private access, and adding personal touches that make the experience extraordinary.

* Make outbound calls to hotels, restaurants, venues, and luxury service providers in the US, UK, and beyond. Representing the company with confidence and professionalism on every call.

* Build and maintain genuine relationships with our partner network so that we get access, prioritisation, and goodwill that others don’t.

* Communicate with members clearly and precisely in writing and on calls, keeping them updated at every step with the right details at the right time.

* Work alongside our internal AI tools to research, draft, and refine recommendations applying your own judgment to every output before it reaches a member.

* Document member preferences, request history, and partner interactions in our systems every time, without being reminded.

* Grow into a leadership position as the department scales. Strong performers will take on increasing ownership of the Lifestyle Manager function.



You’re Perfect for This Role If You

*Have 3+ years in a high-touch, client-facing role serving wealthy or high-profile principals - whether as a personal or executive assistant to a CEO, a VIP or guest relations manager at a five-star location (e.g. The Peninsula Manila, Shangri-La, Solaire, Raffles), or a client relations manager at a luxury brand (e.g. LVMH, Richemont, Rustan’s).

*Speak and write English at a native level. Clear, confident, and polished whether you’re messaging a member or calling a hotel manager in New York or London.

*Have a phone manner that gets results and you’re not rattled by gatekeepers, you know who to ask for, and “fully booked” is never where the conversation ends.

*Have genuine finesse, warm and reassuring with members, direct and effective with partners, and composed under pressure when things don’t go to plan.

*Take full ownership of every request. You follow through without being chased, spot problems before they surface, and never leave something half-done.

*Are comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow, using them to move faster and produce better work, while knowing when your own judgment needs to take over.



Nice to Have:

*Personal familiarity with luxury properties, restaurants, and experiences in NYC, London, Paris, Dubai, Tokyo, or Singapore.

*An existing personal network of contacts at high-end hospitality venues or luxury lifestyle providers.

*Prior experience working with international or foreign employers.

title: Call Center Agent / Customer Service Representative (Inbound & Outbound, Advanced English Required)
description:
We're hiring call specialists to handle live inbound calls and follow-up outbound calls for two lead verticals: behavioral health treatment intake and legal case intake. You'll be the first voice a caller hears, often someone who is stressed, confused, or dealing with a difficult situation, so this role requires advanced English fluency, clear pronunciation, and the ability to stay calm, professional, and reassuring on every call.

Responsibilities



Answer inbound calls from new leads as soon as they come in

Make outbound follow-up calls to existing/aged leads to re-engage and move them forward

Collect and accurately document caller information

Verify and clarify information when callers provide incomplete or conflicting details

Maintain clear, organized notes in our CRM after every call

Follow scripts and intake protocols while still sounding natural, not robotic



Requirements



Fluent, advanced-level English with clear, neutral pronunciation (this is non-negotiable for this role)

Prior experience in call centers, customer service, sales, or intake admin preferred

Comfortable speaking with people who may be upset or confused

Reliable internet connection, quiet workspace, and a good quality headset/mic

Available to work during US business hours

Strong attention to detail and accurate data entry



Schedule: Full-Time, 40 hours/week

How to Apply



Before submitting your application, we need a short voice audition. Go to 
 (no sign up required), click the red record button, allow microphone access, and read the script below aloud at a natural pace.

When finished, click stop. Vocaroo will generate a shareable link to your recording.

Submit your application with your resume, relevant experience, and the Vocaroo recording link included.

Applications submitted without the voice audition link will not move forward to interview.



Voice Audition Script (read exactly as written):

"Hello, my name is __. I'm reading this advanced script to demonstrate my ability to communicate clearly, even when the information is unusually dense and requires absolute control over tone, pacing, and pronunciation.

In high-pressure intake situations, callers may be injured, confused, or upset, and I must simultaneously sound empathetic, precise, and confident. This means I need to articulate complicated instructions, verify sensitive information, and guide the caller through multiple steps without hesitation, mispronunciation, or noticeable accent drift.

For example, I may need to calmly explain that although I cannot guarantee outcomes, I can accurately document the i
, clarify inconsistencies, and ensure their case is evaluated quickly and professionally. Even when a caller speaks rapidly, interrupts, or provides conflicting details, my responsibility is to remain steady, simplify the situation, and deliver reassurance without sounding robotic or overwhelmed.

This script is intentionally challenging, and I appreciate you taking the time to evaluate my clarity, control, and overall communication skills."

title: PPC Manager (Google & Bing Ads)
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced PPC Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across both Google Ads and Bing Ads. The ideal candidate will have a hands-on understanding of both platforms and proven success managing large-scale, complex campaigns with significant budgets. You will be responsible for delivering results-driven campaigns that align with client goals while maintaining a deep understanding of industry best practices. Previous experience working at Google or a strong insider knowledge of Google Ads best practices is highly advantageous.

As a PPC Manager, you’ll be the go-to expert for all things paid search and will have a direct impact on client performance. The role requires a strategic mindset, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to maintain clear and effective communication with both internal teams and clients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Paid Search Strategy & Execution:

Campaign Development & Management: Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads, ensuring they are aligned with client objectives and maximize ROI. This includes campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search.

Keyword Research & Audience Targeting: Conduct extensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Develop comprehensive strategies based on these insights to optimize targeting and bidding.

Campaign Optimization: Continuously analyze and refine campaigns to improve performance metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Implement A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to maximize conversions.

Ad Copy & Creative Strategy: Work closely with the creative team to ensure that ad copy, creatives, and landing pages are optimized for user engagement and aligned with campaign goals.

2. Client Communication & Consultation:

Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing expert consultation on all Google Ads and Bing Ads strategies. Clearly communicate campaign progress, adjustments, and results to ensure client satisfaction and alignment with business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare and present in-depth performance reports, including key performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and actionable insights. Use these reports to showcase campaign successes and provide strategic recommendations for optimization.

Strategic Guidance: Offer strategic recommendations to clients, advising on how to improve campaign performance, expand reach, or address performance challenges. Proactively identify opportunities for growth.

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted advisor on paid search and digital marketing. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, resolve campaign-related issues, and manage client expectations effectively.

3. Budget Management & Performance Tracking:

Budget Oversight: Manage and optimize client budgets across both Google Ads and Bing Ads to ensure campaigns are efficient and within budget. Track and report on budget pacing and ensure that client goals are met while maximizing ROI.

Performance Tracking & Analysis: Utilize Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance in real time. Assess KPIs such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS to ensure campaigns are delivering results within the defined parameters.

Optimization: Make data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns for better performance. Adjust bids, keywords, targeting, and ads based on performance trends and competitive insights.

4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the broader digital marketing team (SEO, Social Media, Creative, Web Development) to ensure that PPC campaigns are integrated into wider marketing and sales strategies. Align campaigns with broader business objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach across all digital channels.

Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure paid search efforts align with company goals and support sales or product launch strategies.

Knowledge Sharing: Actively contribute to knowledge-sharing within the marketing team by educating peers about PPC best practices, emerging trends, and new tools or features in Google Ads and Bing Ads.

5. Industry Trend Awareness & Innovation:

Stay Current with PPC Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads and Bing Ads updates, features, and best practices. Attend webinars, conferences, and industry events to keep ahead of emerging trends and leverage new opportunities for clients.

Test New Strategies: Continuously evaluate and experiment with new tools, bidding strategies, and ad formats to ensure campaigns are always optimized and competitive. Propose new strategies to clients based on these findings.

6. Reporting & Data-Driven Insights:

Regular Reporting: Create and maintain regular performance reports, dashboards, and presentations to track campaign progress, analyze performance trends, and showcase ROI. Present these findings in a clear, concise manner to clients and internal teams.

Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive campaign improvements. Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to both internal and client stakeholders to guide future PPC strategies and decisions.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement and manage proper tracking systems to measure campaign effectiveness and provide accurate reporting on conversions, revenue, and other key metrics.



Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Certifications in Google Ads and Bing Ads are a plus.



Experience:

Proven PPC Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads. This includes experience in Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search campaigns.

Agency or Client Experience: Experience working in a client-facing role, ideally in a digital marketing agency, managing multiple PPC accounts with large-scale budgets.

Experience at Google (Bonus): Previous experience working at Google or within a Google Partner agency is highly desirable, particularly if you have in-depth knowledge of Google Ads best practices, new features, and insights from working directly with the platform.



Technical Skills:

Google Ads & Bing Ads Expertise: Advanced proficiency in managing campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads, including search, display, shopping, remarketing, and video campaigns.

Analytics Tools Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant analytics and tracking tools to measure, report, and optimize PPC campaign performance.

Data Interpretation: Ability to analyze large datasets, interpret complex data, and turn insights into actionable strategies to optimize campaign performance.



Soft Skills:

Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills: Ability to explain complex PPC strategies and performance data in a clear, concise, and accessible manner for clients, internal teams, and stakeholders.

Client Management Experience: Proven experience in building and nurturing strong client relationships. Ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.

Problem-Solving & Proactive Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing campaign issues. Ability to think critically and take strategic action based on data.

Attention to Detail: High attention to detail, ensuring that campaign elements are precise and accurately reflect client objectives, even when working with large volumes of data.



How to Apply:

If you’re an experienced PPC Manager looking for a new challenge, we want to hear from you! Please submit your resume, along with a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Include any specific campaigns or achievements that highlight your expertise with Google Ads and Bing Ads.

Design the Future of Healthcare Spaces—From Anywhere Healthcare environments demand precision, speed, and absolute reliability. Behind every high-performing operating theatre is a team that turns complex engineering into buildable reality.



If you’re an experienced Structural Draftsman who thrives on creating accurate, fabrication-ready designs—and you want your work to directly impact life-saving environments—this is your opportunity.



About the Company:

Go Ignite partners with high-growth international companies to build world-class remote teams in the Philippines. In this role, you’ll support an innovative Australian company specializing in the design and delivery of advanced modular healthcare environments, including operating theatre systems built for precision, efficiency, and rapid deployment.



About the Role:

This is a full-time role (40 hours per week, no weekend work) supporting the design and delivery of modular healthcare systems. You’ll play a critical role in transforming engineering concepts into precise, workshop-ready fabrication drawings using Autodesk Inventor.



Responsibilities:

Develop detailed 3D models using Autodesk Inventor

Produce high-quality fabrication drawings for steel structures and assemblies

Translate engineering concepts into buildable, workshop-ready documentation

Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and project delivery teams

Support design optimisation for prefabrication and modular construction

You’ll work with an international team, gain exposure to advanced prefabrication systems, and be part of projects that demand both technical excellence and real-world impact—all while working remotely.

title: Part-Time Sales Caller — US Home Service Businesses (Remote)
description:
Hours: 2 hours/day, Monday–Friday (~10 hrs/week), split shift

Shift: 11:00am–12:30pm EST and 5:00pm–5:30pm EST

Pay: $150/month base + performance bonuses

Location: Fully remote, anywhere





About the role

We help local home service businesses across the US grow through marketing and lead generation services. As our Sales Caller, your job is straightforward: in the morning/afternoon you call business owners who have already responded to our outreach and get them started on a free trial. In the evening you call back the people who ran their trial that day and close them onto a paid plan.



Every person you call has already shown interest — there is no cold calling.



What your day looks like



11:00am–12:30pm EST — Call new interested leads, explain the service, and book them onto a free trial. You can realistically book 4–5 trials in this window if not more. Keep brief notes on each call.



5:00pm–5:30pm EST — Call back business owners who have already completed their trial. Answer any questions, handle objections, and close them onto a paid plan.



That's your full day. Simple, repeatable, and results-driven.



What we're looking for



Clear, neutral or American-accented English — the business owners you'll speak with are American and need to feel comfortable in the conversation



Confident and natural on the phone — this is a people role, not a script-reading role



Some background in sales, appointment setting, or customer service — BPO experience is a strong plus



Reliable and punctual — you show up for both shifts every day without being chased



Quiet calling environment and a stable internet connection





Performance bonuses

On top of your base pay:



$5 for every free trial you successfully book. Historically 1 in 5 trials converts to a paid client

$50 for every client you close onto a paid plan. We currently close 1 out of 5 trials



On track earnings are around $1350 a month



The more you close, the more you earn. This role has real upside for someone who takes it seriously.



How to apply

Record a short 60–90 second video introducing yourself. Tell us your name, where you're from, your experience with phone sales or customer service, and why this role is a good fit for you.

Applications without a video will not be reviewed.



This video helps us assess your speaking ability, sound quality and accent
