title: Part time PPC Manager (Google & Bing Ads)
description:
Role Overview:

We are seeking an experienced PPC Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across both Google Ads and Bing Ads. The ideal candidate will have a hands-on understanding of both platforms and proven success managing large-scale, complex campaigns with significant budgets. You will be responsible for delivering results-driven campaigns that align with client goals while maintaining a deep understanding of industry best practices. Previous experience working at Google or a strong insider knowledge of Google Ads best practices is highly advantageous.

As a PPC Manager, you’ll be the go-to expert for all things paid search and will have a direct impact on client performance. The role requires a strategic mindset, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to maintain clear and effective communication with both internal teams and clients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Paid Search Strategy & Execution:

Campaign Development & Management: Develop, launch, and manage paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads, ensuring they are aligned with client objectives and maximize ROI. This includes campaigns on Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search.

Keyword Research & Audience Targeting: Conduct extensive keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience segmentation to identify growth opportunities. Develop comprehensive strategies based on these insights to optimize targeting and bidding.

Campaign Optimization: Continuously analyze and refine campaigns to improve performance metrics such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS. Implement A/B testing strategies for ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to maximize conversions.

Ad Copy & Creative Strategy: Work closely with the creative team to ensure that ad copy, creatives, and landing pages are optimized for user engagement and aligned with campaign goals.

2. Client Communication & Consultation:

Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for clients, providing expert consultation on all Google Ads and Bing Ads strategies. Clearly communicate campaign progress, adjustments, and results to ensure client satisfaction and alignment with business objectives.

Performance Reporting: Regularly prepare and present in-depth performance reports, including key performance metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and actionable insights. Use these reports to showcase campaign successes and provide strategic recommendations for optimization.

Strategic Guidance: Offer strategic recommendations to clients, advising on how to improve campaign performance, expand reach, or address performance challenges. Proactively identify opportunities for growth.

Client Relationship Management: Build and nurture strong relationships with clients, becoming a trusted advisor on paid search and digital marketing. Ensure high levels of client satisfaction, resolve campaign-related issues, and manage client expectations effectively.

3. Budget Management & Performance Tracking:

Budget Oversight: Manage and optimize client budgets across both Google Ads and Bing Ads to ensure campaigns are efficient and within budget. Track and report on budget pacing and ensure that client goals are met while maximizing ROI.

Performance Tracking & Analysis: Utilize Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics platforms to monitor campaign performance in real time. Assess KPIs such as CPC, CTR, CPA, and ROAS to ensure campaigns are delivering results within the defined parameters.

Optimization: Make data-driven decisions to optimize campaigns for better performance. Adjust bids, keywords, targeting, and ads based on performance trends and competitive insights.

4. Collaboration & Cross-Functional Alignment:

Team Collaboration: Work closely with the broader digital marketing team (SEO, Social Media, Creative, Web Development) to ensure that PPC campaigns are integrated into wider marketing and sales strategies. Align campaigns with broader business objectives, ensuring a cohesive approach across all digital channels.

Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure paid search efforts align with company goals and support sales or product launch strategies.

Knowledge Sharing: Actively contribute to knowledge-sharing within the marketing team by educating peers about PPC best practices, emerging trends, and new tools or features in Google Ads and Bing Ads.

5. Industry Trend Awareness & Innovation:

Stay Current with PPC Trends: Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads and Bing Ads updates, features, and best practices. Attend webinars, conferences, and industry events to keep ahead of emerging trends and leverage new opportunities for clients.

Test New Strategies: Continuously evaluate and experiment with new tools, bidding strategies, and ad formats to ensure campaigns are always optimized and competitive. Propose new strategies to clients based on these findings.

6. Reporting & Data-Driven Insights:

Regular Reporting: Create and maintain regular performance reports, dashboards, and presentations to track campaign progress, analyze performance trends, and showcase ROI. Present these findings in a clear, concise manner to clients and internal teams.

Actionable Insights: Translate complex data into actionable insights that drive campaign improvements. Provide clear, data-backed recommendations to both internal and client stakeholders to guide future PPC strategies and decisions.

Attribution & Conversion Tracking: Implement and manage proper tracking systems to measure campaign effectiveness and provide accurate reporting on conversions, revenue, and other key metrics.



Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Certifications in Google Ads and Bing Ads are a plus.



Experience:

Proven PPC Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads. This includes experience in Google Search, Display, YouTube, Shopping, and Bing Search campaigns.

Agency or Client Experience: Experience working in a client-facing role, ideally in a digital marketing agency, managing multiple PPC accounts with large-scale budgets.

Experience at Google (Bonus): Previous experience working at Google or within a Google Partner agency is highly desirable, particularly if you have in-depth knowledge of Google Ads best practices, new features, and insights from working directly with the platform.



Technical Skills:

Google Ads & Bing Ads Expertise: Advanced proficiency in managing campaigns across Google Ads and Bing Ads, including search, display, shopping, remarketing, and video campaigns.

Analytics Tools Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of Google Analytics, Microsoft Advertising Intelligence, Google Tag Manager, and other relevant analytics and tracking tools to measure, report, and optimize PPC campaign performance.

Data Interpretation: Ability to analyze large datasets, interpret complex data, and turn insights into actionable strategies to optimize campaign performance.



Soft Skills:

Excellent Communication & Presentation Skills: Ability to explain complex PPC strategies and performance data in a clear, concise, and accessible manner for clients, internal teams, and stakeholders.

Client Management Experience: Proven experience in building and nurturing strong client relationships. Ability to manage client expectations and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner.

Problem-Solving & Proactive Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing campaign issues. Ability to think critically and take strategic action based on data.

Attention to Detail: High attention to detail, ensuring that campaign elements are precise and accurately reflect client objectives, even when working with large volumes of data.



How to Apply:

If you’re an experienced PPC Manager looking for a new challenge, we want to hear from you! Please submit your resume, along with a cover letter outlining your relevant experience. Include any specific campaigns or achievements that highlight your expertise with Google Ads and Bing Ads.

title: QGIS Specialist
description:
Role Overview



The QGIS / GIS Analyst will work on a variety of geospatial projects, including map production, spatial data management, geoprocessing, digitization, data QA/QC, and preparation of GIS outputs for reports, web maps, and client presentations.



This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, comfortable working independently, and able to turn messy spatial data into clean, accurate, professional deliverables.



Responsibilities



The selected candidate will be responsible for:



Creating, editing, and maintaining spatial datasets in QGIS

Producing high-quality maps for reports, proposals, presentations, and client deliverables

Cleaning, geocoding, joining, and validating spatial and tabular data

Performing spatial analysis such as buffers, overlays, intersections, proximity analysis, and site suitability analysis

Working with shapefiles, GeoPackages, GeoJSON, CSVs, rasters, and web map services

Digitizing features from imagery, plans, PDFs, or field data

Building clear map layouts with proper symbology, labeling, legends, scales, and metadata

Troubleshooting coordinate reference systems, projections, and data alignment issues

Documenting GIS workflows and maintaining organized project files

Supporting web mapping or dashboard workflows when needed

Communicating clearly with the internal team about project status, assumptions, and data issues

Required Qualifications

Strong working knowledge of QGIS

Experience with spatial data editing, cartography, and geoprocessing

Understanding of coordinate systems, projections, and spatial data formats

Ability to clean and manage GIS data accurately

Strong attention to detail and map design quality

Comfortable working with attribute tables, joins, field calculations, and expressions

Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

Clear written communication skills

Portfolio or examples of previous GIS/map work

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with PostGIS, PostgreSQL, or spatial databases

Familiarity with Python, PyQGIS, or GIS automation

Experience with web mapping tools such as Leaflet, Mapbox, ArcGIS Online, or QGIS2Web

Experience with remote sensing, raster analysis, or imagery interpretation

Experience with planning, real estate, utilities, environmental, transportation, or municipal GIS projects

Familiarity with GPS/field data collection tools

Experience working with CAD, PDFs, zoning data, parcel data, or public open data portals

Software and Tools



Applicants should be comfortable with some or all of the following:



QGIS

GeoPackage, Shapefile, GeoJSON, CSV, KML/KMZ

OpenStreetMap and public GIS data portals

Google Earth / Google Maps

Excel or Google Sheets

Optional: PostGIS, Python, ArcGIS Online, Mapbox, Leaflet, GDAL/OGR

Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is practical, organized, and precise. You enjoy solving spatial problems, making clean maps, and improving messy datasets. You do not need constant supervision, but you communicate early when something is unclear or when data quality issues arise.



How to Apply

Resume or LinkedIn profile

Brief note describing your QGIS experience

Portfolio, map samples, or links to previous GIS work

Your availability

Your expected hourly rate or salary range



Subject line: QGIS / GIS Analyst Application – [Your Name]



Equal Opportunity Statement

description:
Location: Fully Remote - Work From Home

Job Type: Full-Time

Salary: Competitive, commensurate with experience and role placement



About Our Company



Your Virtual Partner (YVP) is a premier outsourcing and smart staffing solutions company specializing in connecting global talent with high-performing businesses across Australia. We operate as a seamless, virtual extension of our clients' teams, allowing them to scale their operations effortlessly, maximize productivity, and focus on growth.



While we provide tailored outsourcing across various corporate sectors, our core expertise lies in the financial services space. The vast majority of our clients are top-tier professionals within the Australian Mortgage Broking Industry—including residential brokerages, commercial finance firms, and non-bank lenders. Due to rapid expansion and an increasing demand for premium administrative and processing support from our AU broker clients, we are looking for dedicated financial professionals to join our high-performing global workforce.



About the Opportunities



To make our application process seamless, we have consolidated our current hiring needs into a single open application portal. We are actively building out our deal teams and have three (3) distinct career streams available, depending on your professional experience, lending specialization (Residential vs. Commercial), and technical skill set.

Review the profiles below to identify which stream matches your background, and indicate your preferred option when submitting your application.



[CAREER 1] MORTGAGE SUPPORT ASSOCIATE (Residential Focus – Entry to Mid-Level)



Role Overview: The Mortgage Support Associate plays an essential role in helping individuals and families secure residential financing for their homes. Your primary responsibility is to serve as an operational anchor, guiding clients through the intricacies of the home loan application and origination process. You will evaluate client financial goals, match them with suitable loan products, gather critical documentation, and manage files through to underwriter approval while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory standards.



Key Responsibilities:

- Customer Consultation & Guidance: Meet with potential borrowers to explore financial goals, assess mortgage needs, and provide clear guidance on suitable home loan products, interest structures, and lending terms.

- Application & Loan Processing: Assist borrowers with completing comprehensive mortgage applications and meticulously collect all required supporting documents (including income statements, credit reports, and property appraisals).

- Pre-Qualification Assessment: Evaluate borrower financial profiles to determine eligibility across various residential programs and issue formal pre-qualification letters to assist clients in their property search.

- Product Selection & Loan Structuring: Stay continuously updated on diverse mortgage loan products, shifting interest rates, and individual lender guidelines to structure loans that perfectly balance client goals with lending criteria.

- Credit Counseling & Advice: Help clients interpret credit reports, identify viable strategies to improve credit scores, and advise them on how their unique credit history influences their borrowing options.

- Stakeholder Communication: Maintain proactive, regular contact with borrowers, keeping them informed of file status, missing documents, or processing milestone updates.

- Relationship Management: Cultivate and support robust professional relationships with real estate agents, property appraisers, title companies, and lender underwriters.

- Compliance & Ethics: Execute all origination and filing activities in strict compliance with federal and state laws, maintaining the highest ethical standards under the Best Interest Duty (BID).



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Prior experience in banking, mortgage administration, or customer financial services.

- General knowledge of residential lending products, interest rate lock-in procedures, and credit files.

- Exceptional communication and customer service skills, with a passion for helping clients navigate complex financial journeys.

- Strong ethical grounding and attention to compliance detail.



[CAREER 2] MORTGAGE SUPPORT SPECIALIST (Commercial & Non-Conventional Lending)



Role Overview: We are seeking a highly specialized, detail-oriented Mortgage Support Specialist with direct experience in the Australian commercial real estate, private lending, and development finance sectors. In this role, you will serve as the technical and operational backbone of our commercial deal team. You will support brokers through highly complex non-conventional funding structures, ensuring applications meet stringent institutional and private standards and moving high-value files smoothly from initial intake to settlement.



Key Responsibilities:

- End-to-End Commercial Deal Support: Manage processing and administrative requirements for a diverse portfolio of Australian commercial, private, and specialized development finance files.

- Application Packaging: Prepare and assemble highly comprehensive, professional loan application packages for submission to a panel of Australian private lenders, non-bank lenders, and specialist development finance institutions.

- Advanced Document Validation: Meticulously collect, review, and analyze complex commercial and corporate document packages, including:

- Financial Data: Australian Business Number (ABN) records, corporate tax returns, Notices of Assessment (NOA), and Business Activity Statements (BAS).

- Property Records: Valuations from registered Australian valuers, formal Title Searches, and local council planning permits.

- Project Files: Detailed development appraisals, construction costings, sales/revenue forecasts, and full project feasibilities.

- Pre-Assessment & Underwriting Support: Assist in the initial underwriting phase, assessing deal viability against specific, strict Australian lender criteria before submission.

- Professional B2B Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for sophisticated clients and institutional introducers (mortgage brokers, financial planners, commercial accountants), providing technical updates on deal progress.

- Network Coordination: Manage communication and document flows between Australian-based valuers, commercial solicitors, conveyancers, and accounting professionals.

- Rigorous Compliance & Due Diligence: Conduct comprehensive Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing (AML/CTF) and Know Your Client (KYC) checks in absolute alignment with AUSTRAC regulations and Australian Credit Licence (ACL) obligations. Ensure all commercial files comply with the National Consumer Credit Protection (NCCP) Act where applicable.



Ideal Qualifications for this Stream:

- Direct, proven experience supporting brokers or lenders within the Australian commercial real estate or development finance market.

- Deep proficiency in reading and validating corporate financials (ABN, BAS, NOA) and understanding commercial project metrics (feasibility models, construction drawdowns).

- Comprehensive familiarity with AUSTRAC compliance, KYC workflows, and non-bank lending standards.

- Exceptional analytical capacity and sharp attention to detail.



[CAREER 3] MORTGAGE SUPPORT – SR. ASSOCIATE (Residential Expertise & Team Leadership)



Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced and leadership-minded Mortgage Support - Sr. Associate with extensive expertise in the Australian residential mortgage industry. This role requires an advanced understanding of loan structuring, credit policy, and client relationship management. Beyond managing high-tier and complex files, you will demonstrate leadership qualities by driving process optimization, staying on top of tech-stack integrations, and mentoring junior tea
mbers to ensure the overall operational team maintains premium quality output.



Key Responsibilities:

- Advanced Pre-Qualification: Conduct initial high-net-worth client consultations to map out homeownership strategies; evaluate complex serviceability and creditworthiness using tools like Quickli and applying the 5 Cs of Lending.

- Complex Loan Structuring: Educate clients on advanced loan combinations and recommend optimal solutions tailored to multi-property portfolios, expertly balancing fixed vs. variable splits and flexible repayment terms.

- CRM & Pipeline Management: Guide clients smoothly through applications while managing files end-to-end utilizing advanced mortgage CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Creatio, and Salestrekker.

- Secure Document Workflows: Oversee the secure and rapid execution of digital documentation utilizing platforms such as DocuSign and Ezidox, ensuring zero data-integrity errors.

- Credit Analysis & Compliance Auditing: Deeply analyze credit bureau reports, formulate credit improvement roadmaps for clients, and ensure absolute adherence to Australian mortgage regulations, including Loan Estimates and Closing Disclosures.

- Post-Closing & Settlement Excellence: Coordinate final document compilation to guarantee frictionless loan settlements; support clients post-settlement with direct debit structures, offset account setups, and ongoing client care.

- Business Development & Networking: Proactively build and nurture long-term relationships with core referral networks (real estate agencies, accounting firms, wealth managers) leveraging LinkedIn, industry forums, and freelancer platforms.

- Tea
ntorship & System Optimization: Act as an escalation point and mentor for junior support staff; spearhead internal process improvements to accelerate client onboarding and minimize application turnaround times.

mbers, reviewing loan files for quality assurance, or leading process improvements.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Shark
description:
JOB TITLE: HIGH-TICKET CLOSER / REAL ESTATE ACQUISITIONS SHARK



Enterprises Elite ( IG 470K+ 
/enterpriseselite/ ) is a real estate investment company that is rapidly scaling our virtual wholesaling operation. Our marketing machine is generating more leads than our current team can handle. We do not need help finding leads; we need a killer to close them.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS

We are looking for an experienced, relentless remote Acquisitions Manager. You will be taking warm leads, running property comps, negotiating directly with American homeowners, and locking up real estate contracts.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

This is not a customer service or basic virtual assistant role. This is not for order-takers or appointment setters. If you are overly polite, afraid of conflict, or fold the second a seller gets aggressive, do not apply. We need a shark. We need someone who is perfectly comfortable telling a homeowner their house needs $40,000 in work, making a low offer, and confidently sitting in the awkward silence.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Call warm, inbound leads and follow up with our CRM pipeline. Quickly analyze properties using online tools to determine the After Repair Value (ARV) and Maximum Allowable Offer (MAO). Build deep rapport with distressed sellers, uncover their actual pain points, and overcome brutal price objections. Negotiate heavy discounts and secure digital contracts.



REQUIREMENTS TO WIN

PERFECT ENGLISH: Your spoken English must be flawless, with high confidence and strong tonality.

EXPERIENCE: You must have a proven track record of closing high-ticket B2B/B2C sales, preferably in U.S. real estate wholesaling.

TECH FLUENT: You must know how to navigate CRMs and run comps.



THE COMPENSATION

We offer a highly competitive base hourly rate to give you stability, plus an aggressive, uncapped commission bonus for every single contract you lock up that closes. If you are a true closer, you will make significantly more here than standard VA roles.



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

If you just click apply and send a generic resume, it will be instantly deleted. To prove you have attention to detail and strong communication skills, you must follow these exact steps:



STEP 1: Make the subject line of your message exactly ELITE CLOSER - [Your Name]

STEP 2: Do not send a cover letter. Instead, record a short 60 to 90-second video of yourself on your phone or webcam.

STEP 3: In the video, introduce yourself, tell us about your highest-ticket sales experience, and explain exactly why you would be a killer fit for this acquisitions role.

STEP 4: Upload the video to Google Drive, Dropbox, or YouTube (make sure the privacy is set so anyone with the link can view it) and paste the link in your application.



If you cannot sell yourself on a short video, you cannot close our leads. We look forward to seeing your pitch.

description:
About Us

This is NOT a VA role and NOT a junior dev role. You'll be the technical builder for the business, working directly with the owner (who built the current systems and knows them deeply — you won't be guessing alone).



Our Stack (you'll work across most of this)



-Zapier (advanced: code steps, webhooks, paths, error handling — not just simple Zaps)

-Airtable (automations, scripting, complex base design, API)

-Pipedrive CRM (API, webhooks, workflow automation)

-ActiveCampaign (automations, API)

-Python (Flask services deployed on Google Cloud Run)

-REST APIs generally — reading API docs and building reliable integrations is the core of this job

-LLM integrations (Claude / OpenAI APIs — building automations that use AI models via API)

-WordPress — custom code (PHP/HTML/CSS/JS), performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals), and ongoing site management. Not just themes and plugins — you must be able to work in the code.

-Google Tag Manager & tracking — GTM container setup, dataLayer coding, UTM parameter architecture, conversion tracking (including server-side / Conversions API)

-Cloudflare, DNS, domains & hosting — DNS records, security settings, SSL, domain management (GoDaddy etc.), hosting environments

-Softr (client portal on top of Airtable)

-Plus: SMS APIs (Twilio/Sinch), Meta Conversions API, and AI voice APIs



You don't need experience with every tool — but you MUST be strong on Zapier + Airtable + APIs + Python + WordPress (real coding, not just plugins), and able to learn the rest fast from documentation.



What You'll Do



-Build new automations and improve existing ones (lead routing, CRM workflows, client notifications, and LLM-powered automation systems)

-Own our WordPress website end-to-end: performance (Core Web Vitals), custom code changes, design polish, and reliability

-Own our tracking infrastructure: GTM, dataLayer, UTM architecture, and conversion tracking accuracy across Meta and Google

-Manage the infrastructure layer: Cloudflare, DNS, domains, hosting, SSL, and security settings

-Innovate with AI. We use LLMs heavily across our systems and expect you to stay current with new models, tools, and techniques — and to proactively propose where AI can improve or replace existing processes. "I saw this new capability and built a prototype" is the energy we pay bonuses for.

-Debug production issues by finding root causes — not patching symptoms

-Integrate third-party APIs by reading official documentation carefully and verifying exact parameter specs (this is a hard requirement for us — guessing at API parameters is how systems break)

-Write clear documentation: every automation you ship comes with a written spec and runbook. No exceptions.

-Proactively identify problems and improvements before being asked — we pay bonuses specifically for this



Compensation



-Base: USD $2,500–3,000/month depending on experience

-Monthly performance bonus: USD $300–800 based on shipped systems that run reliably, documentation quality, and -proactive problem-finding. Opportunity to go even higher, based on performance.

-Annual base increases for strong performers

-Long-term, stable, full-time role — we are building for years, not months



Hours Of Work



Full-time, Monday–Friday, working - 9am - 6pm SYDNEY TIME.



Who This Role Suits



-5+ years building automations, integrations, and websites professionally — you're a senior generalist who's comfortable owning the entire technical surface of a business, not a specialist in one tool

-You're a problem solver and have a high degree of attention to detail

-You chase root causes, not symptoms — "I found why it breaks" instead of "I added a workaround"

-You read API documentation for fun (or at least without pain)

-You're genuinely excited by AI — you already use LLMs in your own workflow, follow new releases, and have built things with -AI APIs because you wanted to, not just because a client asked

-You test your own work before calling it done

-You communicate clearly and proactively — if something is blocked or broken, we hear it from you first

-You want one stable long-term client who pays well and pays bonuses, not five gigs



Who This Role Does NOT Suit



-Anyone whose Zapier experience is limited to simple two-step Zaps

-Anyone whose WordPress experience is page builders only (Elementor/Divi) — if you can't work directly in PHP/HTML/CSS/JS and diagnose performance issues in the code, this isn't your role

-Anyone who hardcodes credentials or guesses at API parameters instead of checking docs

-Anyone juggling multiple clients (we require exclusivity during work hours)

-Agencies, teams, or anyone planning to subcontract any part of this work. We are hiring you, one individual — the person we interview is the person who does the work, always. Given the financial data our systems handle, subcontracting is treated as a serious breach and grounds for immediate termination.

-Anyone uncomfortable with logged/audited system access — we run strict security practices (scoped credentials, audit trails). Honest builders find this boring; that's the point.



Security Note (read this — it matters)



We work with financial data, so we follow least-privilege access practices: you'll use your own named accounts and scoped API keys, production credentials are managed by the owner, and system activity is logged. This is standard, professional, and protects you as much as us. If that sounds reasonable, we'll get along great.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS



Required:



-Zapier (Expert)

-Airtable (Expert)

-AI Tool Use — Claude Code / ChatGPT (Expert)

-API Integration / REST APIs (Expert)

-WordPress — custom code & performance (Advanced)

-Google Tag Manager / UTM / conversion tracking (Advanced)

-Python (Advanced)

-HTML / CSS / JavaScript (Advanced)

-Webhooks (Advanced)

-Cloudflare / DNS / domain & hosting management (Intermediate–Advanced)



Strongly preferred:



-Pipedrive or similar CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce)

-ActiveCampaign or similar (Mailchimp, Klaviyo)

-Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions)

-Flask or similar Python web frameworks

-Meta Conversions API / server-side tracking



Nice to have:



-Softr / no-code app builders

-Twilio / Sinch / Kixie, SMS APIs

-SQL





HOW TO APPLY



To apply, send a message that includes ALL of the following — applications missing any item will not be read:



1. Start your message with the word "PINEAPPLE" so we know you read the full post.



2. Your 2–3 best automation/integration projects — for each: what it did, which tools/APIs were involved, and one problem you hit and how you solved it. Specific detail matters more than polish. Include links wherever possible — live websites you've built or optimised, GitHub, portfolio, or Loom walkthroughs. Claims we can verify are worth far more than claims we can't.



3. Answer this question: A Zapier webhook step is receiving data from a third-party API, but one field arrives blank for about 4% of records even though the source system shows the data exists. Describe, step by step, how you would diagnose this. (There is no single right answer — we're looking at how you think.)



4. Answer this question: A WordPress landing page scores poorly on Core Web Vitals (high CLS, slow LCP) and its Meta conversion tracking is undercounting leads. Briefly: what are the first things you'd check for each problem?



5. Your expected monthly salary in USD.



6. Confirm you can work 9:00am–6:00pm Sydney time (including the earlier Manila start during Australian daylight saving) full-time and exclusively.



7. A short video introduction (3–5 minutes, camera on) — Loom or similar. Briefly: who you are, what you've built that you're proudest of, and what specifically about this role appeals to you. No script needed, no editing, no polish — we just want to meet the actual person we'd be talking to every morning.



If you're selected, we'll contact you back to arrange a quick interview to see if we're a good fit to work together.

The primary goal of this position is to protect the business owner's time. You will ensure we **never miss a single new lead**, handle inbound/outbound calls seamlessly, and get quote appointments booked on our calendar so the owner can focus on high-level operations.

We are a growing business based in Fernandina Beach, Florida. Because we are growing, call volume fluctuates. You might only handle a handful of calls a day, which means there will be a significant amount of "filler time." 



We don't want that time wasted. A small portion of your downtime will be spent scheduling social media posts, but the **majority of your downtime will be spent working on our SEO.** > ?? **Please Note:** We will provide comprehensive course materials, but this is **not** a passive studying role. You will be expected to learn a concept from the course and immediately execute and do the actual SEO work on our website and Google Business Profile. You are being paid to actively learn and implement high-value SEO strategies.



Additionally, we want to scale efficiently. We need someone who can look at our GoHighLevel (GHL) setup, bring their own expertise to the table, and help us polish, streamline, and build clean Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for our CRM and business operations.



### Key Responsibilities

* **Elite Phone & Lead Management:** Answer inbound calls instantly, respond to texts/emails/social messages, pull necessary information online (property details, maps, etc.) to help the owner provide an accurate quote, and book the quote appointment.

* **GoHighLevel (GHL) Optimization:** Review our current GHL workflows, clean up automations, and bring your expertise to streamline our CRM processes.

* **Active SEO Execution (During Downtime):** Go through our provided SEO training modules and directly execute those strategies in real-time on our website and Google Business Profile. You will be doing the actual, live SEO work.

* **Documentation:** Work with the owner to organize our daily processes into clear SOPs for future field technicians.



### What We Are Looking For

* **Exceptional Phone Presence:** Your spoken English must be awesome, confident, and friendly. You must be comfortable picking up the phone and talking to American homeowners/businesses.

* **GoHighLevel Experience:** Highly preferred. We want someone who already knows their way around GHL and can help us make the system run smoother. 

* **Resourceful & Hands-On Learner:** You don't need a manager holding your hand. If you are given an SEO course module or need to figure out a GHL workflow, you are the type of person who dives in, researches, figures it out, and gets the job done.

* **Reliability:** Excellent internet connection, a quiet workspace, a backup power/internet solution, and a commitment to being 100% responsive during US business hours.



### Benefits & Culture

* Stable, full-time hours with weekends off.

* Paid active training (you get paid while learning and implementing high-level SEO).

* Reliable, weekly payments via Wise.

* Performance-based pay increases as you successfully book appointments and optimize our operations.



---

title: Remote Operations Manager / Integrator
description:
Integrator / Project Manager + Right Hand to the CEO — Accounting & Tax Firm



Company:(U.S. Accounting & Tax Firm)

Work setup:100% remote, full-time

Schedule: 8:00 PM – 2:00 AM Manila time to start, Monday–Friday (overlaps U.S. Central Time mornings)

Salary: $6–10 USD/hour to start, depending on experience

Reports to: CEO / Firm Owner



---



About Us



We're a boutique U.S. accounting and tax firm serving around 400 clients, with deep roots in agriculture, construction, and small business. We run a fully remote team across the U.S. and the Philippines, and we run our firm on EOS (the Entrepreneurial Operating System / "Traction"). We're building a modern, technology-driven firm that uses smart systems and automation to do great work without the chaos.



We're looking for a sharp, self-driven Integrator who can help run the tax office and be the CEO's right hand for getting things done.



The Role



This is a blended, high-trust role with one clear main priority and a strong supporting half:



- About 60% — Integrator / Project Manager for the tax office (your main priority).You help the CEO run and manage the firm: leading the weekly meeting, tracking the team's Rocks and projects, and keeping the work on deadline.

- About 40% — Right hand to the CEO. You help the CEO get her firm-building projects out the door — publishing the weekly newsletter, posting blogs and social media (she provides the copy), helping with SOPs and videos, organizing Google Drive, developing client education and communications, and keeping her teams across several related companies pulling together.



In plain terms: the CEO sets the direction; you own how it actually gets done. If you already know what an Integrator, a Rock, and a Level 10 Meeting are, you'll feel right at home. If you don't yet, you should be eager to learn the system fast.



Everything in this role is accounting and tax focused — you'll live in the rhythm of tax season, deadlines, and the monthly close.



What You'll Do



Help Run & Manage the Tax Office — Your Main Priority (~60%)



- Lead the weekly tea
eting (EOS Level 10–style) — run the agenda, work the issues list, and assign to-dos

- Follow along with staff Rocks (quarterly priorities) and projects, keeping everyone on target and on deadline

- Own day-to-day project management — assignments, due dates, and bottlenecks across tax season and the monthly close

- Direct and support staff, holding the team accountable to outcomes

This emerging field is called GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and it's where search is heading. We work with growth minded businesses that want to stay visible as discovery shifts from blue links to AI answers. Founded by a serial entrepreneur who has built and scaled multiple ventures, the company is small, fast, and built for the new era of AI enabled search.

The role

This is a delivery and execution role. The strategy is handled. What we need is someone who makes sure the work actually ships: audits run on schedule, fixes get implemented, reports go out, and nothing slips through the cracks across a growing list of retainer clients.

You're detail oriented, technically strong, and the kind of person who finishes what they start and keeps systems running without being chased. You'll execute, audit, and improve technical SEO and GEO performance across multiple client sites, and you'll help build the workflows and SOPs that keep everything reproducible as we grow.

A new way of working

title: Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
About the company

At Miraco Nutripharm, we are dedicated to advancing health & improving lives. Our goal is to relieve 1 billion people worldwide of pain & discomfort. If you know of anyone who has been worried about or suffered from any health problems, join us in making a positive impact by reducing the pain & distress others have to endure.



Job Description

We are looking for an Digital Marketing & E-commerce Specialist to be the visionary link between our brand identity & measurable e-commerce performance. You will shape how our health brands communicate across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & social media. This role is responsible for developing high-impact creative strategies & producing assets (visual, video, copy) designed to drive traffic, increase conversion rates & drive overall revenue growth for our Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok E-Commerce stores. You will work across multiple channels & markets to plan, create & optimize content that builds awareness, strengthens partnerships & supports the expansion of our business. You won't just be creating content; you will be engineering 'Performance Stories' that turn scientific evidence into consumer trust & measurable revenue. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing creativity, analytics & brand strategy in the health supplement industry. 



Key Responsibilities



1. Creative & Performance Strategy

*Full-Funnel Content: Craft tailored strategies for B2C & B2B audiences optimized for platform-specific formats (e.g. Meta carousel ads, Meta/TikTok Reels, Shopee/Lazada e-commerce banners & Klaviyo
/whatsapp marketing)

*A/B Testing & Data Insights: Develop clear hypotheses for creative elements (hooks, CTAs, visual styles) & run A/B tests to improve Click-Through Rates (CTR) & Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Audience Segmentation: Translate target audience data & segmentation provided by media buyers into resonant creative themes, ensuring content speaks directly to different stages of the marketing funnel (awareness, consideration, conversion)

*Competitive Intelligence: Identify emerging hooks & messaging trends in the wellness/supplement industry to keep our brands ahead of the curve



2. In-House Content Production & Execution 

*Performance Creative Development: Lead end-to-end creative production for organic & paid media (Meta, TikTok, Google/YouTube) with a focus on high-volume, quick-turnaround testing

*Video & Static Creation: Rapidly produce & edit native social content, including:

-Video: Fast-paced assembly of UGC-style content, product demos & testimonials (CapCut/Premiere)

-Static: Adapting product photography into high-performing ad variations & storefront banners

*Generative AI Integration: Utilize AI tools & prompt engineering to efficiently generate high-quality video & image assets for rapid testing cycles

*Copywriting: Write high-converting ad copy, landing page headlines & captions that align with brand voice & regulatory requirements

*Asset Management: Ensure all campaign assets are correctly tagged, archived & deployed across Shopify, Shopee, Lazada & TikTok storefronts



3. E-commerce Growth & Social Account Management

*E-Commerce Storefront Custodian (Shopify, Shopee, Lazada, TikTok): Integrate winning creative messages into e-commerce storefronts (product pages, banners) to ensure a seamless customer journey for maximum sales conversion

*Social Accounts Ownership & Community Manager: Act as the "Brand Guardian" for Miraco’s official accounts on Meta (FB/IG) & TikTok. Ensure all profiles are optimized for conversion, featuring up-to-date bios, Linktree/Shopify integrations & high-lighted stories

*Content Programming & Scheduling: Develop & maintain a consistent content calendar that balances "Digital Pearls" (educational), Lifestyle (relatable) & Promotional (sales-driven) posts

*Active Social Listening: Use comments & DMs to identify "pain points" to fuel new content hooks

*User Generated Content (UGC) Mining: Identify & curate customer testimonials from the community to use as high-converting growth assets

*Growth Analytics: Monitor account health metrics (Follower growth, Engagement Rate, Profile Visits) & use these insights to refine the organic reach strategy

*Data-Driven Optimization: Work with the Marketing Manager to analyze performance reports, identifying which creative variables are driving revenue on Shopify & Marketplaces. Apply insights & analytics to refine content effectiveness continuously



4. Performance Media & Technical Tracking

*Paid Media Execution (Meta & Google): 

-Meta Ads Manager: Build, launch & manage conversion-focused campaigns (Advantage+ Shopping, Catalog Sales & Manual Retargeting) to drive traffic to Shopify & Marketplaces

-Google Ads (PMAX & Search): Oversee Performance Max & Search campaigns to capture high-intent health & supplement queries

*Precision Tracking & UTM Tagging: Implement a standardized UTM tagging nomenclature across all Digital Pearls, EDMs, WhatsApp blasts & Affiliate links to ensure 100% attribution accuracy in Google Analytics 4 (GA4) & Shopify

-Monitor the "customer path" from the first touchpoint (e.g., a Meta post) to the final conversion (e.g. e-commerce purchase, loyalty program subscription, etc.)

*Media Optimization: Manage ad spend budgets effectively, focusing on scaling winning creatives & "killing" underperforming ads based on real-time ROAS & CPA data



5. CRM, Loyalty & Lifecycle Marketing (Retention & CLV)

*CRM Management, Loyalty & Monetization: Serve as the lead strategist for the CRM loyalty program, designing lifecycle journeys that move customers from "First-Time Buyer" to "Loyal Subscriber"

- Develop loyalty-driven content that rewards repeat purchases & encourages long-term brand advocacy to maximize *Consumer Lifetime Value (CLV)

Electronic Direct Mailer (EDM) & E-Newsletter Strategy: Develop & execute a high-frequency E-newsletter calendar via Klaviyo. This includes:

-Educational Newsletters: Delivering "Digital Pearls" & expert insights from our HCP partners to build brand authority

-Promotional EDMs: Creating high-converting seasonal offers & product-launch campaigns

*Automated Flow Management: Design & execute end-to-end
 & WhatsApp marketing automation (eg. Klaviyo) to nurture leads & re-engage existing customers

-Automated Lifecycle Flows: Building "Welcome" series, "Post-Purchase" care, "Win-back" flows & "Replenishment Reminders"

*Subscription & Monetization: Craft compelling creative & copy for "Subscribe & Save" programs, focusing on reducing churn & maximizing monthly recurring revenue (MRR)

-Optimize the "Subscribe & Save" funnel through targeted
 & WhatsApp triggers, focusing on increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) & Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR)

*WhatsApp Marketing: Integrate direct-to-consumer WhatsApp communication for personalized health consultations, loyalty rewards & rapid-response promotions

*Data-Driven Personalization & Segmented Campaigns: Segment the CRM database based on health concerns, purchase behavior & engagement levels to ensure the right story reaches the right customer at the right time



6. Influencer & Affiliate Strategy (E-Commerce Growth & Acquisition)

*Creator Partnerships: Identify & manage relationships with health influencers & HCP advocates via Shopify Collabs, TikTok Creator Marketplace & similar platforms

*Affiliate Creative Kits: Develop high-converting "Affiliate Toolkits" (ready-to-use stories, hooks & banners) that empower partners to sell Miraco products effectively

*Performance Tracking: Monitor affiliate-driven traffic & conversion data to optimize commission structures & creative briefs for better ROAS



7. Growth-Driven Storytelling

*Translating Science to Story: Distilling complex clinical data & health benefits into relatable, high-impact stories that resonate with a consumer’s pain points & emotional aspirations

*Narrative Funneling: Crafting story arcs specifically designed for the customer journey, from "educational hooks" that capture attention to "empathy-led consideration" to "urgency-driven conversion"

*Growth-Centric CTAs: Developing persuasive, multi-variant Calls-to-Action (CTAs) that don't just ask for a click but provide a compelling reason to engage, directly impacting Click-Through Rates (CTR) & customer acquisition

*Performance Iteration: The ability to pivot a brand story based on real-time data insights, identifying which "angle" or "hook" is driving the highest Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)

*Omnichannel Cohesion: Ensuring a seamless visual & narrative experience across all touchpoints, from high-energy social media (Meta/TikTok) to professional platforms (LinkedIn) & offline trade materials

*Compliance & Brand Integrity: Safeguarding brand credibility by ensuring all "Performance Stories" remain factual, align with company values & strictly compliant with regional healthcare advertising standards & product claim guidelines. Partnering with internal teams to audit content for accuracy & compliance prior to regional deployment



Requirements:

-3–5 years of experience in full-stack digital growth, with a track record of managing end-to-end performance campaigns (Meta/Google), official social accounts (Meta/TikTok) & e-commerce growth (Shopify is a plus)

-Ability to move customers through the funnel—from initial awareness to community loyalty—ideally within the healthcare or wellness sectors

-Proven experience managing or creating content for Shopify, TikTok, Shopee & Lazada ecosystems. Familiarity with e-commerce metrics (AOV, CR, ROAS) is essential

-Hands-on experience with Meta Ads Manager & Google Ads

-Strong understanding of social media trends & platform best practices (Meta, Google, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Generative AI)

-Hands-on proficiency in Klaviyo (highly preferred), HubSpot, or Zoho CRM for
 & mobile marketing

-Track record of managing or growing a brand loyalty club with a focus on retention & community building

-Experience navigating Shopify Collabs, TikTok Marketplace, or similar affiliate management software

-A solid understanding of the "Growth Equation": CAC, ROAS, AOV & CLV

-Expert in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, Premiere Pro), CapCut, Canva, Figma, or similar tools

-Experience using Generative AI tools (e.g., Gemini AI, Midjourney, Sora/Runway) for rapid asset prototyping & production

-Excellent writing, editing & visual storytelling skills. Adopt a strategic approach to design that integrates marketing & commercial goals

-Familiarity with regulatory communication standards or track record in health supplements or healthcare industry is a plus.

-Excellent communication, project management skills & the ability to work cross-functionally

title: GTM Systems & AI Operations Specialist
description:
GTM Systems & AI Operations Specialist

Reporting to: The Founder

Working Hours: Full-time, UK business hours (Mon-Fri, 9:00am-5:30pm GMT/BST)

Compensation: £1550 per month for 160 hours



The Role

This is a high-impact, full-time hire acting as the Founder’s right hand across systems, outbound, AI implementation, and light product work.



The business has shifted. We no longer build outbound systems alone — we build outbound, CRM, automation, and AI enablement for clients and ourselves, with Claude Code as the mission control for everything we do. 



We use Claude Code every single day. Most of our processes live inside it. We are looking for someone AI-native, technically confident, and genuinely comfortable building with AI as the operating layer, not as a side tool.



The single most important trait we are hiring for is the way this person thinks. 

The right mindset and critical thinking around AI is the foundation everything else is built on. Tool experience (Clay, Instantly, HeyReach) is teachable. 

The thinking - knowing how to direct AI, sense-check its output, and stay sharp instead of accepting whatever it gives you - is not. 



We would rather hire someone with a strong systems brain and genuine AI fluency, and teach them Clay from scratch, than hire a Clay expert who can’t think clearly with AI.



The Founder will continue to lead strategy, sales, creative direction, and content. You will take ownership of:



Building and running outbound systems (course signups, founder leads, client campaigns) using Claude Code, Clay, n8n, and connected APIs

Implementing AI workflows and signal-based pipelines that reduce cost (less Clay credit dependency, more direct API + Claude orchestration)

Light web/dev work — landing pages, platform tweaks, dashboards, internal tools — built inside Claude Code

Helping deliver client builds (outbound, CRM, automation, AI enablement)

Taking operational pressure off the Founder so he can focus on content and the inbound engine



This is not an “operations-only” or “Clay specialist” role.

You will be a systems thinker who speaks AI fluently, plays a critical role in revenue generation, and helps grow the business across multiple surfaces simultaneously.



Core Responsibilities



1. Claude Code & AI Operations (Mission Control) - ~30%

Operate inside the company’s Claude Code environment as your daily working surface

Build, refine, and run AI-driven workflows, skills, and automations inside Claude Code

Use Claude (and Claude Code specifically) to design and implement systems — not as a chat tool, but as an execution layer

Prompt-engineer at a high standard. Generic AI output is not acceptable.

Plug Claude into Clay, n8n, and external APIs to build cost-efficient signal-based pipelines

Continuously look for ways to replace expensive tooling (e.g. high Clay credit spend) with direct API + Claude orchestration



2. Outbound Systems & Campaign Management - ~25%

Build and run outbound systems to generate course signups and founder leads (our primary internal target)

Manage outbound campaigns across:

Instantly and Lemlist 
)

HeyReach (LinkedIn)

Responsibilities include:

Sequence setup and testing

A/B testing and optimisation

Domain/inbox rotation and deliverability

Monitoring and handling replies

Copy amendments (full copywriting = a plus)

The Founder will set outbound strategy; you implement it on the tools



3. Clay & Data Systems - ~15–20%

Build and manage Clay tables for prospecting, enrichment, segmentation

Implement waterfall enrichment, AI columns, and scalable list-building

Maintain clean, high-quality datasets

Clay is still important — but we are moving toward Claude Code + Clay together, and toward replacing Clay-only steps with cheaper API-based alternatives where possible



4. Light Web / Platform / Dev Work - ~15%

Spin up landing pages and lightweight websites (Claude Code-driven)

Make tweaks and improvements to the platform we’re building (Next.js + Clerk + Supabase + Stripe stack)

Build client-facing dashboards and internal tools

Edit and maintain existing websites

You do not need to be a senior engineer — you need to be confident shipping working code inside Claude Code and unafraid of touching a codebase or using AI to edit one.



5. Client Delivery Support - ~10–15%

Build and manage outbound, CRM, and automation systems for client projects

Support delivery of AI enablement work (Claude Code, automation, signal pipelines) for clients

Ensure builds are reliable, scalable, and produce measurable results

Potential to take increasing ownership of client-facing delivery over time



Must-Have Skills & Experience

Genuine AI literacy — confident, daily user of frontier AI models. Knows how to get a non-generic, production-grade result out of a model. Comfortable with Claude specifically.

Claude Code (or willingness to become expert fast) — comfortable working inside an AI-driven workflow repo, running skills, executing prompts, editing files, working with version control

Systems thinking — understands how outbound, CRM, automation, and AI connect at the framework level. Can design and implement an end-to-end system, not just operate one tool.

Technical confidence — unbothered by code, APIs, terminals, and unfamiliar tools. Can read a stack trace, follow documentation, debug independently.

Light dev capability — can ship landing pages, make site edits, and tweak existing apps with Claude Code’s help

Ability to learn at speed — this is a fast-moving, ever-changing environment. The next six weeks (MFOS platform launch) are make-or-break. You will not have time to ramp slowly.

Strong written English communication (client-ready level)

Experience with B2B outbound / lead generation systems — at least foundational

Clay experience (table building, AI columns, waterfall enrichment) — bonus, not required. We will teach it.

Instantly, Lemlist, HeyReach experience

n8n workflow building (especially self-hosted)



Nice to Have

Attio, Airtable, or similar CRMs

Supabase / PostgreSQL

Next.js / React / Tailwind — for platform work

Git / version control

Experience with API orchestration, especially using AI to coordinate between tools

Experience working in a GTM agency, modern revenue-ops, or AI-native environment



Ideal Candidate Profile

The thinking is the role. Tool experience can be taught. 

Thinks clearly with AI — knows how to direct an AI to a sharp, non-generic, production-grade result. Pushes back on weak output rather than accepting it.

Thinks like an operator AND a strategist

Thorough and militant on providing work of a high standard

AI-native — treats AI as an everyday operating layer, not a novelty. Comfortable being left alone with the tools to get a job done.

Strong systems brain — sees how the pieces connect and how to build the next piece

Moves fast, pivots fast, learns fast. Comfortable in a high-change, founder-led environment.

Honest about gaps — proactively flags what they don’t know so we can move them forward quickly, instead of getting stuck quietly

Comfortable following instructions when needed and operating independently when not

Generates ideas, not just executes them

Proactive, accountable, organised, and direct



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

Operating confidently inside Claude Code as the primary working environment

Independently building and running:

Outbound campaigns for course signups and founder leads

Clay tables and enrichment workflows

AI-driven signal pipelines (Claude Code + Clay + APIs)

Light landing pages and platform tweaks

Managing all active campaigns without daily oversight

Contributing to course pipeline, platform growth, and client delivery

Reducing Founder involvement in operations and delivery from 15–20 hours/week ?

title: Amazon Influencer VA + Video Editor

We run an Amazon Influencer and short-form product video operation, creating a high volume of simple product review videos for Amazon, TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. We are hiring a long-term Amazon Influencer VA + Video Editor who can work nightshift, stay organized, communicate clearly, and turn raw product footage into clean, consistent videos with minimal hand-holding. Applications that do not start the title with NIGHT0WL will be ignored. This is not a one-off gig. 



We are looking for someone who wants steady long-term work, can follow SOPs, and can improve through feedback. Most edits are simple, repeatable product videos: trimming dead space, picking the best clips, adding captions/text, cleaning audio, keeping pacing tight, exporting correctly, and helping keep our product/content pipeline organized.



The Amazon Influencer side of the role matters too. You may help track products, organize raw footage, rename files, update spreadsheets, prepare upload details, check that videos match the product, write simple titles/descriptions, and help us keep daily output moving.



Responsibilities:

- Add captions, text overlays, hooks, zooms, b-roll, screenshots, and basic motion where needed

- Improve pacing, remove filler/dead space, clean up audio, and keep exports consistent

- Create short-form versions when needed for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or other social platforms

- Help organize product footage, folders, links, exports, and spreadsheets

- Match videos to the correct Amazon products and avoid mixing up product details

- Prepare simple upload titles/descriptions when requested

- Follow SOPs, checklists, and feedback notes carefully

- Communicate during your shift and flag blockers quickly



Must-Haves:

- Able to work nightshift long-term to match Pacific Time Zone

- Experience editing videos

- Product research and review

- Fast, stable internet

- Strong written English and clear communication

- Very detail-oriented with file names, product names, links, and instructions

- Able to take feedback and apply it on the next edit

- Organized enough to manage many products/videos at once without losing track



Schedule:

Long-term nightshift role to match Pacific Time Zone. Please include your timezone and the exact hours you can work each day. We prefer someone who can commit consistent hours.



How to Apply:

In your message, include confirmation of the must-haves and the following:

1. A short intro about your experience

2. Your video editing portfolio, especially product review, UGC, TikTok/Reels/Shorts, Amazon Influencer, or ecommerce examples

3. Which editing software you have and can use

4. Your internet speed or speedtest screenshot

5. Your timezone and the hours you can work nightshift to match Pacific Time Zone

6. Confirmation that you are comfortable with repetitive, high-volume product video work

7. Any Amazon Influencer, TikTok Shop, or affiliate-content experience you have



Also include C4T in your application title and if you are selected, we will send a small paid trial task to test your research, attention to detail, communication, and editing ability. It will include 2 videos, raw footage only with an expected 48 hour turnaround.

- 1 edited and published long form YouTube video per week

REQUIREMENTS:

- Mastery of the English language (spoken and written)

- Strong project management skills and ability to hit volume targets consistently

- Comfortable reviewing analytics and making basic performance recommendations

- Quiet environment to work



We will ask you what your favorite dog breed is, answer chowchow in your application so we know you have read the full job posting.



TECH REQUIREMENTS (MINIMUM):

- Computer: Windows 10/11 PC or Mac (released within the last 4–5 years)

CPU: Intel i7 / Ryzen 7 / Apple M1 or better (or equivalent)

RAM: Minimum 16 GB (32 GB strongly preferred)

Storage: At least 512 GB SSD, with 150+ GB free for active projects

GPU: Dedicated graphics card with 4 GB VRAM or more (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 1660 / RTX series or equivalent). For Mac, M1/M2 with integrated GPU is fine.

Must be able to run Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects smoothly while having multiple Chrome tabs, cloud drives, and AI tools (Descript / Opus Clip / etc.) open.

title: Growth Marketing Assistant
description:
Who we are:

ColdBru is a next-gen DTC growth team that partners with DTC brands to drastically improve their growth trajectory when other options don't move the bottom line. Our purpose is to help people learn, grow and be the best versions of themselves through the journey of entrepreneurship. We are committed to being the unfair advantage behind our partner brands, and launching a group of our own brands to operate.



We value being fast, data-driven, customer-centric, and adaptable in our approach.

Simply put, ColdBru is the unfair advantage behind its partners' bottom-line growth.



What you'll do (EST time zone overlap required):

Support our growth team in the trenches of performance marketing and AI-powered customer experience optimization.



Execute day-to-day performance tracking and reposting across Meta, Google Ads, and TikTok campaigns - you'll be the one catching data discrepancies before they become problems and keeping our reporting bulletproof.



Assist with campaign setup and launches across multiple advertising channels, helping our media buyers move fast without breaking things.



Manage AI customer service tools across multiple client accounts - you'll be optimizing AI systems, reviewing AI responses for brand consistency, and escalating the complex stuff that needs human touch.



Generate performance summaries and insights that actually matter, not just vanity metrics (we're all about that bottom-line impact).



Help maintain marketing calendars, campaign schedules, and project timelines so nothing falls through the cracks.



Support various growth experiments and initiatives - when we need to test something new, you'll be right there helping make it happen.



The Growth Marketing Assistant will work closely with our media buying and growth teams.



We move fast and details matter - if a campaign is off by even 1% in tracking, you catch it. If an AI response doesn't sound like our client's brand, you fix it. You're the safety net that lets our team swing for the fences without worrying about the fundamentals. If you get this, put your go-to productivity hack in ALL CAPS in the first line of your application.



Who you are:

You have some experience in digital marketing, social media, or performance marketing and you're hungry to level up fast.



You're obsessed with getting things right the first time and have an eye for details that others miss. You can juggle multiple projects without dropping the ball and actually enjoy the puzzle of troubleshooting data discrepancies.



You're looking to learn from a world-class team and want hands-on experience with the tools and strategies that drive real growth at scale.



Nice To Have/Bonus Skills:

- Experience with Google Analytics,
 
, or other marketing analytics tools

- Familiarity with AI customer service platforms or chatbot management

- Knowledge of Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or other advertising platforms beyond Meta

- Experience with project management tools (Asana, 
, Notion)

- Basic understanding of marketing automation



Where we're going:

We're a team of handpicked individuals hell-bent on profitable growth for the sake of it, we get up in the morning energized to crack the latest growth problems wide open just cause it sounds fun. We wouldn't settle for anything less and don't take 'No' for an answer. No task is too big or too small, if it's needed to achieve profitable growth we find a way to do it or get it done. We aren't on a hiring spree and will only onboard someone on the same wavelength. That being said, if you think you can outperform and don't have all the experience above, we're open to chatting - ownership and follow-through are what we really care about.



Benefits:

Learn from a world-class team leading the space

In 6 months you'll learn more than other people learn in 3 years

Essentially unlimited self-improvement budget (online courses, and other educational experiences)

Retreats

Flexible working hours

Flexibility to work from anywhere in the world (need to overlap with PST work hours)

Performance incentives

A coffee stipend, if you work at ColdBru you don't pay for coffee. Period.

A wellness budget, we care about your physical and mental well-being, this stipend is there to help you with it, however you see fit.

No meetings Friday, and if you get all your work done by Thursday, take Friday afternoon off!



To apply
 
 & put coffee as your word to be considered

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
## Senior Video Editor — Narrative Film & TV



**Location:** Fully remote · **Type:** Full-time · **Compensation:** $5,000/month USD · **Reports to:** Post-Production Supervisor



### About us



We're a stealth-stage narrative studio building premium episodic and short-film work — think prestige storytelling with a small, senior-heavy team. We're keeping details under wraps for now; more on the slate and the team once we connect.



### The role



We're looking for a senior editor who cuts story, not just footage. You'll take projects from assembly through final picture lock — shaping performance, pacing, and structure in close partnership with directors and writers. This is a craft-led ownership role at the top of our editorial bar: you'll be trusted with entire episodes or films and expected to have a clear point of view about why a cut works.



### What you'll do



- Build assemblies, rough cuts, and fine cuts for narrative projects, making decisive choices about performance, rhythm, and scene structure.

- Partner directly with directors and showrunners through the cut, translating notes into edits and pushing back thoughtfully when the story calls for it.

- Own pacing and tone across a piece — finding the emotional spine of scenes and the throughline of the whole.

- Manage your own media end to end: organize footage, sync dailies, maintain clean project hygiene and version control across a remote pipeline.

- Prep and hand off cuts for sound, color, and VFX, and integrate temp music, sound, and visual placeholders to sell a cut.

- Set editorial standards and mentor junior editors and assistants across projects.



### What we're looking for



- 6+ years editing narrative film and/or scripted television, with a reel that demonstrates story sense — not just technical polish.

- Mastery of at least one professional NLE (Premiere Pro, Avid Media Composer, or DaVinci Resolve) and the adaptability to work in a studio's chosen toolchain.

- A strong instinct for performance and pacing — you can feel when a scene runs a beat too long.

- A track record of carrying projects through multiple rounds of director's notes without losing the thread of the story.

- Fully self-directed in a remote setting: excellent communication, disciplined file management, and reliable delivery against deadlines without supervision.



### Nice to have



- Experience with remote review workflows (
, Evercast, or similar).

- Working knowledge of sound design, color, or motion graphics — enough to spec the handoff well.

- A specific genre or tonal strength (drama, comedy, thriller) that matches our slate.



### Details



- **Compensation:** $5,000/month USD, full-time

- **Time zone:** Async-friendly, with occasional live review sessions; some overlap with AEST business hours preferred.

- **To apply:** Reply to this listing with your reel and a short note on a cut you're proud of and why.

title: E-Commerce Video Editor
description:
OVERVIEW

We are looking for a skilled VSL (Video Sales Letter) Editor who can craft long-form, high-converting video content for e-commerce and DTC brands. This is not a short-form or social media role — you will own the full VSL production pipeline, turning raw scripts, footage, and voiceovers into polished sales videos that drive measurable revenue outcomes.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

• VSL Production: Edit full-length VSLs (typically 5–30 minutes) from provided scripts, voiceovers, and b-roll footage — structured to maximise viewer retention and purchase intent.

• DR Structure & Flow: Apply proven Direct Response frameworks: strong hook and problem identification in the opening segment, benefit-stacking through the body, and a high-urgency close with clear CTA.

• Visual Storytelling: Build compelling visual narratives that support the sales script — using text overlays, callouts, product close-ups, testimonial segments, and supporting graphics to reinforce key selling points.

• Audio & Pacing: Master voiceover pacing, background music layering, and sound design to maintain engagement throughout long-form content. Silence and timing are as important as visuals.

• Iteration Based on Data: Produce A/B testing variants (different hooks, CTAs, segment reordering) based on performance feedback — view-through rate, drop-off points, and conversion data.

• Platform Optimisation: Export and format VSLs for web-hosted sales pages, YouTube pre-roll, and
 funnels. Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement.

• Asset Management: Maintain organised project files, source footage, and export versions for handoff to media buyers and funnel builders.



MUST-HAVES

• Proven VSL editing portfolio — at least 2–3 examples of long-form sales videos (not short-form ads or brand content) with demonstrated conversion outcomes.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with clean, well-structured timelines.

• Deep understanding of Direct Response marketing: you know what a hook, a benefit stack, a proof section, and a close look like — and how to pace them visually.

• Experience working with voiceover-led content and synchronising visuals to narration beats.

• Comfort with text-heavy editing — callouts, chapter titles, emphasis overlays, and on-screen proof elements (screenshots, testimonials, stats).

• Performance mindset — you treat data (watch time, drop-off, CVR) as creative direction, not criticism.

• Reliable fast turnaround: first cuts within 48 hours; revisions within 24 hours.



BONUS SKILLS

• Experience with animated explainer-style segments or whiteboard/kinetic typography within VSLs.

• Proficiency in After Effects for lower thirds, animated callouts, and motion graphics.

• Familiarity with VSL hosting platforms (Wistia, Vimeo, ClickFunnels embedded video).

• Understanding of funnel architecture — how a VSL fits into a sales page, order bump, and upsell flow.

• Experience editing for supplement, info-product, or high-ticket e-commerce VSL formats.



ENGAGEMENT DETAILS:

Schedule Flexible / output-based — strict deadlines apply

Onboarding Paid trial project before transitioning to ongoing engagement
