title: Shopify SEO, AEO, GEO & AI Automation Specialist
description:
Job Description: Shopify SEO, AEO, GEO & AI Automation Specialist

About Us

We are a fast-growing digital marketing agency helping ecommerce and Shopify brands improve their website visibility, conversion, customer retention, and long-term revenue growth.

We work across areas such as website optimisation,
 marketing, customer journey improvement, SEO, AI search visibility, content strategy, and AI-driven marketing systems.

As search continues to evolve beyond traditional Google rankings, we are building a future-focused SEO service that helps ecommerce brands become more discoverable across Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other AI-powered search platforms.

The successful candidate will support both our agency’s own websites and our ecommerce client websites. Brand names and client details will be shared during the interview or onboarding process.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Shopify SEO, AEO, GEO & AI Automation Specialist to join us on a part-time, freelance, or contractor basis, with the potential to transition into a longer-term role based on performance and client demand.

This role is not just traditional SEO.

We are looking for someone who understands Shopify SEO, ecommerce search intent, content strategy, answer engine optimisation, generative engine optimisation, and AI-powered workflow automation.

Your role will be to help our agency and our Shopify/ecommerce clients become more visible across both traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, while also helping us build repeatable AI-assisted workflows for SEO audits, content briefs, optimisation recommendations, reporting, and service delivery.

Key Responsibilities

1. Shopify SEO Strategy & Execution

• Develop and execute SEO strategies for Shopify ecommerce brands.

• Optimise Shopify collection pages, product pages, homepage content, blogs, and landing pages.

• Conduct keyword research, competitor research, and search intent mapping for ecommerce categories.

• Improve metadata, headings, product descriptions, internal linking, image alt text, and page structure.

• Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic, rankings, conversions, and revenue.

• Provide practical SEO recommendations that are easy for ecommerce teams to implement.

• Ensure SEO recommendations support both search visibility and customer conversion.

2. AEO — Answer Engine Optimisation

• Structure content so it can answer customer questions clearly and directly.

• Create and optimise FAQ sections for product pages, collection pages, landing pages, and blog content.

• Improve content formatting for featured snippets, People Also Ask, and AI-generated summaries.

• Help ecommerce brands answer high-intent questions such as:

o “Best product for…”

o “How to choose…”

o “What is the difference between…”

o “Is this product suitable for…”

o “How does this compare to…”

• Ensure content is clear, useful, commercially relevant, and easy for both humans and search engines to understand.

3. GEO — Generative Engine Optimisation / AI Search Optimisation

• Optimise websites and content for AI search platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and other emerging AI discovery tools.

• Improve content structure for AI retrieval, summarisation, and citation.

• Build topical authority around key ecommerce categories, products, services, and brand entities.

• Recommend ways to improve brand mentions, entity recognition, trust signals, structured content, and content depth.

• Monitor how brands appear in AI-generated responses and identify opportunities to improve visibility.

• Help ecommerce brands become more likely to be discovered, referenced, or cited in AI-powered search experiences.

4. Technical Shopify SEO

• Conduct technical Shopify SEO audits.

• Review indexing, crawlability, sitemap, robots.txt, canonical tags, redirects, duplicate content, and collection/product page issues.

• Review Shopify theme structure and identify SEO limitations.

• Recommend and implement structured data/schema improvements where appropriate.

• Identify site speed and Core Web Vitals issues that may impact SEO performance.

• Work with developers where required to implement technical improvements.

• Identify Shopify-specific SEO issues such as duplicate URLs, collection/product duplication, pagination issues, tag pages, filter/indexing issues, and thin collection content.

5. Ecommerce Content Strategy

• Create SEO, AEO, and GEO-focused content strategies for Shopify brands.

• Plan blog topics, buying guides, comparison articles, product education content, and collection page content.

• Create content briefs for writers or AI-assisted content workflows.

• Ensure content supports both search visibility and ecommerce conversion.

• Identify content gaps across the customer journey:

o Awareness

o Consideration

o Purchase

o Retention

• Recommend content that helps customers make better buying decisions.

• Create topic clusters that build authority around product categories, customer problems, and ecommerce niches.

6. AI Automation & SEO Workflow Development

A key part of this role will be helping us build AI-powered automation systems for our SEO, AEO, and GEO services.

We are looking for someone who can help design, test, and improve repeatable workflows that make SEO delivery faster, more consistent, and easier to scale across multiple Shopify clients.

This may include helping us build workflows for:

• Shopify SEO audit automation

• AI search / GEO visibility checks

• Keyword clustering and search intent mapping

• SEO content brief generation

• Blog outline and article draft workflows

• Product page optimisation recommendations

• Collection page optimisation recommendations

• FAQ and AEO content generation

• Internal linking suggestions

• Schema and structured data recommendations

• Monthly SEO reporting automation

• Google Search Console insight summaries

• Competitor content gap analysis

• AI-assisted content repurposing for blogs, FAQs,
 newsletters, and LinkedIn posts

The ideal candidate does not need to be a full-stack developer, but should be comfortable working with AI tools, prompts, spreadsheets, SEO tools, and automation platforms.

Experience or interest in tools such as ChatGPT, Claude code, Perplexity, Google Sheets, Zapier, Make, n8n, Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, SurferSEO, or similar tools will be highly regarded.

The goal is to help us create a repeatable AI-powered Shopify SEO, AEO, and GEO delivery system that can support both agency growth and client service delivery.

7. Agency Website SEO & Growth Support

In addition to client work, you will also support SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI search visibility for our agency’s own websites.

This may include:

• Improving organic visibility for our agency websites.

• Creating SEO and AI search strategies for our service pages.

• Optimising blog content, landing pages, and service pages.

• Identifying keyword and content opportunities.

• Improving internal linking and content structure.

• Creating content briefs for authority-building articles.

• Monitoring how our agency appears in AI search tools and Google results.

• Helping us build inbound lead generation through SEO and AI search visibility.

Reporting & Client Support

• Track SEO performance using Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, SurferSEO, or similar tools.

• Prepare simple, practical monthly reports showing traffic, rankings, indexed pages, content opportunities, and recommended actions.

• Summarise Google Search Console insights into clear next steps.

• Explain SEO and AI search recommendations clearly to non-technical clients.

• Help build repeatable SEO/AEO/GEO processes that can be used across multiple Shopify clients.

• Focus reporting on visibility, traffic quality, commercial intent, and revenue opportunities — not just rankings.

Requirements

• Proven SEO experience, preferably with ecommerce or Shopify brands.

• Strong understanding of Shopify SEO, including product pages, collection pages, blogs, navigation, internal linking, and technical limitations.

• Experience with on-page SEO, technical SEO, content SEO, and keyword research.

• Understanding of AEO, structured content, FAQ optimisation, and search intent.

• Strong interest or experience in GEO / AI search optimisation for platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

• Ability to create practical SEO recommendations that support business growth, not just rankings.

• Experience using SEO tools such as Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, SEMrush, Screaming Frog, SurferSEO, or similar.

• Comfortable using AI tools and creating repeatable prompt-based workflows.

• Strong written communication skills.

• Ability to work independently and provide clear deliverables.

• Commercial mindset with an understanding of how SEO supports ecommerce revenue.

Bonus Points

• Experience optimising Shopify collection pages for commercial search intent.

• Experience with schema markup and structured data for ecommerce.

• Experience with AI-assisted content workflows.

• Experience creating SEO content briefs for writers or AI tools.

• Experience with Klaviyo, ecommerce conversion optimisation, landing page optimisation, or
 marketing.

• Understanding of how influencer marketing, UGC, reviews, backlinks, and brand mentions support SEO and AI search visibility.

• Experience building workflow templates, SOPs, or automation systems.

• Experience with Make, Zapier, n8n, Airtable, Google Sheets automation, or API-based workflows.

• Ability to turn SEO processes into scalable service delivery systems.

What You’ll Be Working On

You may work across:

• Shopify SEO audits for ecommerce clients.

• Product page and collection page optimisation.

• SEO/AEO/GEO content systems.

• AI search visibility reports.

• Shopify technical SEO recommendations.

• Monthly SEO support for client brands.

• Blog and content strategies for ecommerce brands.

• Agency website SEO and AI search visibility.

• Internal frameworks and delivery processes for SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI search services.

• AI automation workflows that make SEO delivery faster and easier to scale.

Initial Deliverables

The first phase of this role will focus on helping us build a repeatable Shopify SEO, AEO, GEO, and AI automation delivery system.

You may be asked to create:

1. Shopify SEO audit checklist

2. AI search / GEO audit checklist

3. Shopify collection page optimisation template

4. Shopify product page optimisation template

5. Blog content brief template

6. Internal linking checklist

7. Schema and structured data checklist

8. Monthly SEO/AEO/GEO reporting template

9. Google Search Console insight summary workflow

10. Keyword clustering and search intent workflow

11. AI-powered SEO content generation workflow

12. Client-facing SEO/AEO/GEO recommendation template

13. Agency website SEO and AI search growth plan

Role Structure

• Part-time, freelance, or contractor role to start.

• Flexible hours.

• Remote work available.

• Opportunity to grow into a long-term role based on performance and client demand.

• Must be comfortable working across multiple ecommerce brands.

• Ideal for someone who enjoys both SEO strategy and building repeatable AI-assisted systems.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone who understands that search is evolving beyond traditional Google rankings.

The right person should be:

• Strong in Shopify SEO

• Curious about AI search and generative search engines

• Comfortable with AI automation and workflow building

• Commercially minded

• Practical and execution-focused

• Able to explain SEO simply

• Focused on traffic, visibility, authority, conversion, and revenue outcomes

• Comfortable building repeatable processes and frameworks

We do not want someone who only focuses on backlinks and generic keyword rankings.

We want someone who can help ecommerce brands become easier to discover, understand, trust, and buy from — across both Google and AI-powered search platforms.

How to Apply

Please include:

• Your Shopify SEO experience

• Examples of ecommerce SEO results you have achieved

• Any experience with AEO, GEO, AI search, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google AI Overviews

• Examples of Shopify product or collection pages you have optimised

• Any experience building AI-assisted SEO workflows, automations, SOPs, or reporting systems

• SEO and AI tools you are experienced with

• Your preferred hourly rate or monthly contractor rate

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Who is Bare?



Bare is one of Australia’s fastest growing businesses, in one of the most traditional industries in the world — the funeral industry.

We exist to make end-of-life care accessible, affordable and transparent, changing the way Australians deal with death. For too long, the industry has delivered expensive, traditional, cookie-cutter services that don’t reflect how modern Australians want to say goodbye.

By combining empathy with technology, we’re creating end-of-life experiences that are simple, personalised and affordable. In just five years, we’ve supported more than 40,000 families, become Australia’s most awarded end-of-life provider (recognised for customer service, innovation and digital disruption), and built a team of 100+ passionate people.

And we’re just getting started.

As part of our continued growth, we’re looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to join our finance team.



So, what’s the role?



This is not your typical Senior Financial Analyst role. You’ll work closely with our VP Finance and senior leadership team, helping to drive financial insight and discipline across one of Australia’s fastest growing companies.

You’ll play a key role in financial analysis, reporting, forecasting and business partnering, turning financial data into meaningful insights that support smart commercial decisions.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, ideal for someone who enjoys digging into the numbers, improving processes, and influencing business decisions.



You’ll be responsible for:



-Preparing monthly financial reports, dashboards and P&L analysis, including clear variance commentary

-Owning the budgeting and forecasting processes across multiple entities

-Building and maintaining financial models to support planning and decision-making

-Providing financial insights and analysis to support senior leadership and operational teams

-Partnering with State Leads and department heads to monitor performance and improve margins

-Assisting with reconciliations and financial data accuracy across systems

-Supporting compliance with BAS, PAYGW, FBT and other regulatory requirements

-Assisting with audit preparation and working with external auditors

-Identifying opportunities to improve financial processes and reporting efficiency

-Leading the implementation of automation, AI tools and improved reporting frameworks

-Report to Finance Manager and working closely with senior stakeholders



What will set you apart from other candidates:



-You’re analytical and commercially minded, able to turn data into meaningful insights

-You enjoy solving problems and improving processes

-You’re comfortable working in fast-paced, high-growth environments

-You’re highly organised and able to manage multiple priorities

-You take ownership and initiative, proactively identifying opportunities for improvement

-You’re curious and interested in leveraging technology and automation in finance



What you’ll bring:



-A Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

-CPA, CA or CMA qualification (or working towards) highly regarded

-5+ years’ experience in financial analysis, reporting

-Strong experience with financial reporting, forecasting and variance analysis

-Advanced Excel / financial modelling skills

-Experience with Xero or similar accounting systems

-Strong communication skills and the ability to present financial insights clearly to non-finance stakeholders



What’s in it for you?



-This isn’t your ordinary finance role, in your ordinary company. You’ll join an entrepreneurial, inclusive culture where we succeed together. We offer autonomy, flexibility and real ownership. No two days are the same — and that’s exactly how we like it.



In addition, we offer:



-Strong opportunities for career growth and progression

-A high-performing and highly engaged team environment

-Autonomy and flexibility, including work-from-home options

-A competitive remuneration package

-The opportunity to help transform an industry and make a real human impact



The main reason you’ll join, however, is because you believe in what we’re building. You’re excited by growth. You want to help scale a business that is genuinely changing lives — and you want your finance expertise to be part of that journey.



Please include your resume in your application. Thank you!
